# Accepted baseline: how to use this specification


## Loxada Entertainments — Locked Business Specification


### 1. What has been agreed

Loxada Entertainments now has an accepted business baseline. The company structure, business offers, workflows, approval rules, information requirements and reporting meanings in this specification are the starting point for subsequent design and development. DFDs, ERDs, star models, galaxy models, snowflake models, backend behavior, frontend screens, Figma interactions and analytical transformations must preserve those meanings.
The lock prevents silent changes. It does not make an error permanent, prevent an improvement or require every future design choice to be decided in advance. A proposed change to business behavior must identify its consequences, receive the appropriate acceptance, and produce a new baseline version. Technical and visual choices that preserve the approved behavior may be developed within the baseline and documented in their own artifact versions.
The controlling identifier is LOXADA-BUSINESS-BASELINE-1.0, version 1.0, accepted on 24 October 2026, using Asia/Manila for the acceptance date. Decisions D33 and D34 retain the previously accepted scope, rights, authority and classroom accounting rules. D35 records the user's acceptance of the reviewed information and operating rules. D36 records the business freeze, downstream obligations and controlled-change requirement. The user's acceptance statement was: “I accept all.”
The exact controlling source set is the twenty-two-file manifest in knowledge-system/specs/phase_a_locked_baseline.json. Its source paths, declared views and SHA-256 digests identify the accepted content. The earlier reviewed repository snapshot was commit 90412e96443c048f74f429eb3329a1fe35811931 in despairarc000/loxadaentertainments. That identifier describes the reviewed pre-acceptance snapshot; it must not be confused with the later acceptance record or a claim that every repository branch has been merged.
This specification freezes the academic business and logical information design. It does not claim that final diagrams, a physical database, native interactive Figma files, a backend or a deployed application already exist. Those are derived deliverables. Their completion requires their own artifacts and tests. Likewise, an accepted classroom policy is not an actual supplier contract, copyright grant, payment confirmation or authorization to collect real personal information.
The accepted package covers 151 business process families: 38 for Manga & Light Novel, 45 for Anime, 50 for Merchandise and 18 for company governance. It defines 35 authority purposes, 144 local record shapes, 1,452 specific local fields, 189 actions, fifteen shared reporting-evidence families, eight report definitions and 34 measures. The shared logical registry contains 63 concrete types and 119 explicit aliases. These counts identify the declared specification inventory; they are not counts of implemented services, database tables or final DFD boxes.
The detailed chapters and appendices are part of this specification. They preserve each source process ID, record definition, action contract, conditional state rule, authority purpose and report definition. This opening narrative explains how those details fit together. When a short description here does not carry an entire field-level condition, use the corresponding detailed contract rather than inventing a default.

### 2. Company purpose and organization

Loxada Entertainments is a fictional entertainment company for a university Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence study. It combines three distinct businesses: digital publishing, paid streaming and physical merchandise retail. Each department administers its own operations and prepares its own analytics. The company Owner receives appropriately approved summaries and decision cases across those businesses.
The study follows a business fact from its source to an appropriate decision. A creator submission may become a published edition after its required checks. A verified advertising statement may support an income calculation. A paid streaming period may create a service obligation and subsequently earned revenue. A physical delivery may support goods revenue and the matching original inventory cost. None of these conclusions may be substituted for another merely because they concern the same title, customer or supplier.
There are exactly three operating departments: Manga & Light Novel, Anime, and Merchandise. There is one Owner / Super Admin. Central governance, central analytics, ETL and the warehouse are company services, not a fourth selling department. Four planned system interfaces therefore represent three operating businesses and one company-governance interface.
Each department has an independently administered operational environment, its own OLTP data, local ETL and local analytical mart or OLAP facilities. Central receives only approved exports at their declared grain. The Owner's integrated view does not turn Central into a shared operational database or grant unrestricted access to departmental customer histories.
The selected commercial scope is deliberately distinct. Manga & Light Novel offers one free reader funded through evidenced advertising entitlement. Anime offers one prepaid streaming subscription. Merchandise offers one storefront selling accepted available goods. Their suppliers, contracts, revenue events, obligations and customer actions remain different even where the departments refer to the same intellectual property.
The scope excludes cinema and event ticketing, an alternative Manga reading subscription, Anime trials or automatic renewal, and unsupported alternate Anime plans. Merchandise initially covers posters or art prints and apparel. Figures and collectibles, preorders, backorders, cash on delivery, dropshipping, an internal factory and a multi-seller marketplace are outside the selected baseline.
One external prime producer or lead manufacturer is accountable for a particular commissioned project. This does not require the entire company to use only one supplier. Replacing a project's accountable lead is a controlled novation or material change; it cannot leave the project with contradictory overlapping lead responsibilities.
A popularity signal can justify investigation. It cannot grant adaptation rights, approve investment, create a purchase order or manufacture stock. The intended cross-company sequence is evidence, feasibility review, an actual Owner decision, the receiving department's independent rights and financial gates, then execution under the applicable contract and stage.

### 3. Roles, rights and independent authority

Department administrators run their business within current delegation and approved budget. Suppliers and customers submit their own information or requests. Rights reviewers assess the actual permission for the requested use. Finance reviewers assess obligations, classification, beneficiary and financial evidence. Authorized payment operators execute approved instructions. Warehouse and quality roles record custody and inspect goods. The Data Steward governs identity mappings and report definitions. The Owner decides company strategy, investment and cases that exceed or fall outside delegation.
A role label supplied in a request is not authorization. Each action must verify the actual identity, department, object, purpose, current role and applicable scope. A person may hold several roles in the classroom scenario, but cannot request and independently approve the same restricted case. If genuine separation cannot be demonstrated, the case remains on hold for an independent authorized reviewer.
Rights remain specific to the subject and use. The permission categories include digital publication, digital translation, Anime adaptation, Anime streaming, merchandise manufacture, character-art use and merchandise sale. A grant identifies the work, edition, episode or product category; the authorized party and signer; its evidence revision; territory, language and channel; its effective interval; and relevant dispute or revocation state.
A valid window begins inclusively and ends exclusively. At the exact end instant, a new affected action is outside that grant. Missing, disputed, revoked, future, expired or category-mismatched permission blocks the affected use. Funding, a positive feasibility result, quality acceptance and audience demand cannot override that block. Different compatible grants may overlap; contradictory exclusivity requires review rather than a blanket assumption that all overlap is invalid.
Paying for commissioned animation or artwork does not by itself establish all copyright or exploitation rights. Adaptation permission, contribution and produced-work rights, and permission to stream the completed Anime are distinct gates. Merchandise artwork permission and permission for a particular manufactured category are also distinct. A poster grant cannot silently become an apparel grant.
Routine nonexclusive licensing, wholesale replenishment and ordinary purchasing may be authorized locally up to and including PHP 50,000, but only with current written delegation, correct department and action scope, supported full related exposure, available approved budget and required independent rights and Finance checks. PHP 50,000.01 requires escalation. An unknown amount or unresolved related-obligation grouping produces HOLD, not a zero-value approval.
Every new Anime commission, every new exclusive Merchandise manufacturing project and every exclusive IP grant requires the Owner at any amount. Material scope, rights or exclusivity changes, budget increases and other specified exception purposes require the corresponding new authority. Approval for a tender envelope, investigation or sample stage does not authorize a contract, production, bulk manufacture or release outside its exact scope.
The related obligation includes applicable stated fees, taxes and amendments. Splitting one commitment into installments, documents or accounting years does not reset the threshold. Conversely, a shared supplier alone does not prove that unrelated purchases are one obligation. The grouping must be independently supported.
Delegation is versioned and scoped by department, action, risk and currency. It lasts no more than twelve calendar months and can end earlier through revocation. Commitment authority and payment authority have different clocks. Expiry stops new or increased commitments under the old decision, but does not erase an existing valid liability. Paying that liability still requires a currently authorized operator, independent financial verification and the original supported terms.
The PHP 2,000 routine customer-remedy limit belongs to Merchandise. An eligible routine retail remedy at or below that amount requires the Merchandise administrator and independent Finance verification. Above-limit, fraud, dispute or exceptional cases follow their specified Owner and Finance route. This is an internal approval boundary, not a reason to discard a customer complaint or erase a required remedy. It is not imported into Anime subscriber remedies.
The authority catalogue separates request, intake, independent outcome and local receipt. A request does not approve itself. A receipt of a case is not a decision. A conditional decision does not execute unmet conditions. A timeout or portal view is not a genuine local receipt. Thirty-two department-origin cases are distinct from the three delegation notices that originate with Central; the latter do not require a fictional department request.

### 4. Manga & Light Novel

Both Manga supplier paths converge on one free publishing and reading service. The first path starts with an independent creator. The second acquires authorized catalog content from a publisher. They share editorial, release, reader, advertising and reporting capabilities where those business meanings genuinely match, while retaining different supplier and agreement evidence.
An independent creator applies, establishes identity and authority, declares a work and relevant rights, and agrees to the exact publication and advertising terms. A work can have an honest draft before every supplier-verification or approval step is complete. It cannot become a mapped, approved or published record simply because the applicant created that draft. Required signatures, their verification and the independent rights and financial findings are separate records and actions.
Content submission identifies the actual version. Validation and editorial decisions identify the exact submitted assets. Publication requires a cleared effective grant and accepted release version. A previously accepted version does not automatically authorize another edition, translation, platform or later period. Creator withdrawal, amendments, beneficiary issues and third-party rights notices have explicit review paths rather than disappearing behind the original successful application.
The publisher path verifies the organization's representative and authority, its framework and the applicable title or edition grant. Catalog imports preserve the original publisher, namespace, batch, row and external edition identifiers. Native external identifiers are not silently relabelled as locally generated records. Collisions and uncertain canonical mapping receive an independent identity review.
A registered publisher is not proof that every supplied title is licensed. The grant must cover the required edition, language, format, territory, term and advertising use. A fixed publisher fee remains separate from any agreement-supported advertising share. Minimum guarantees, recoupable advances and more complex royalty arrangements are outside the initial financial case unless approved through controlled change.
Free reading and signed-in analytics are different questions. Anonymous reading may be permitted where the applicable release allows it. The accepted signed-in engagement report does not silently treat anonymous activity as authenticated unique accounts. A reading attempt represents actual authorized delivery, not a page refresh. Completion belongs to the original start cohort and the exact release's required end, rather than an invented percentage threshold.
Advertising income comes from the verified statement basis, not from multiplying reads by an assumed price. A statement revision contains its full verified position. The separate ledger delta records the change from the previous position. Creator shares require the actual attributable work basis and effective agreement fraction. A 30% example is not a universal rate, and zero upfront cash does not imply zero total contractual exposure.
Creator corrections use a complete reviewed allocation manifest. It identifies current allocations and explicitly closes displaced keys. A corrected beneficiary must not leave the previous beneficiary's full obligation active. Legitimate co-beneficiaries may use different agreed fractions of the same evidenced work basis; the work income is counted once. Missing allocation evidence is not automatically company-retained income.
For an illustrative PHP 1,000 attributable basis at 30%, the earned creator position is PHP 300. Correcting the basis to PHP 800 gives a full creator position of PHP 240 and a ledger change of minus PHP 60. The replacement report uses PHP 240. If PHP 300 has already been paid, a reviewed recovery or credit case is required; the correction does not automatically take cash back.

### 5. Anime

Anime licenses completed titles through one path and commissions new production through another. Both paths converge on one paid streamer. A completed acquired title does not need a Manga ancestor. An adapted commission needs its own source adaptation permission; it cannot borrow publication rights from the Manga department.
Acquired-title work verifies the licensor, title and episode scope, commercial terms, effective streaming grant and media delivery. Quality checks and catalog readiness refer to exact media versions. Financial commitments remain identified by the license agreement. Subscription revenue is not allocated to that title because subscribers watched it.
Commissioned work uses one accountable external prime producer per project. Investigation, a tender, contract commitment, development, pilot, production and release have distinct authority. An investigation or tender envelope is nonbinding within its stated scope; it is not a notice to proceed with paid production. The signed prime agreement, actual required rights and relevant project authority must be in place before the authorized execution stage.
Adaptation rights, produced-work and contribution rights, and streaming rights must all be assessed where relevant. The prime manages its subcontractors under the contract's specific permission and must support the chain of title. Intermediate deliverable acceptance does not prove final streaming clearance. Changing the prime, price, rights or material scope triggers the corresponding change or novation review and surviving-liability reconciliation.
The accepted customer offer is PHP 200 prepaid for exactly thirty days, meaning 2,592,000 UTC seconds from independently verified actual activation. There is no automatic renewal, trial, grace period, queued next period or overlapping second purchase. One unresolved checkout is allowed per account and offer. A new purchase is rejected while current entitlement or its unresolved checkout makes it ineligible. A late or extra verified capture is recorded for reconciliation or remedy; it is not silently converted into another access period.
Playback is the intersection of permissions. The account's paid status, current territory and applicable audience conditions, the selected title's rights, media readiness and relevant restrictions are checked for the actual requested content. A billing entitlement does not mean every title is playable. A rights restriction on one title does not automatically extinguish every unrelated account or grant.
Captured cash creates its separate financial fact. It does not immediately prove that all thirty days of service have been delivered. Earned access service uses supported provided intervals and a reviewed allocation of net consideration. Voluntary nonuse is different from verified service loss: a subscriber need not watch to receive available access, while a material platform outage is not treated as provided service merely because the clock advanced.
Credits, refunds and service scope remain linked without double deduction. A pre-service concession from PHP 200 to PHP 180 allocates the new net price over the full promised service period. Twelve and eighteen provided days yield PHP 72 and PHP 108. A credited non-delivery portion has its scope and reduction recorded explicitly. A full approved pre-service refund leaves zero net consideration, zero earned and zero remaining service consideration; the cash refund settles that same financial remedy.
D34 subscriber calculations use exact rational duration, centavo HALF_UP and a deterministic final residual. Ten fully provided days of the unadjusted offer yield PHP 66.67 earned and PHP 133.33 remaining. Fractional activation near a Manila month boundary is retained exactly. A segment's promised denominator must equal its declared interval, and the segments must cover the original paid period. A true-up reference cannot turn one second of provided service into a full month's earnings.
The viewing measure named watch_seconds means unique eligible content seconds per attempt. It is not elapsed wall-clock watch time. At double speed, 120 content seconds can take sixty wall seconds. Overlapping pings or repeated playback of the same interval within one attempt are unioned; a separate valid replay attempt can contribute again.

### 6. Merchandise

Merchandise buys authorized finished goods wholesale and commissions exclusive posters, art prints or apparel through an external lead manufacturer. Both paths feed the same accepted-stock retail service. An internal SKU has one immutable source path. Visually similar wholesale and commissioned variants retain different sourcing identity rather than being merged into an unsupported common financial pool.
Wholesale procurement verifies the supplier, lawful source and relevant resale or artwork permissions, current delegation or Owner authority, agreed purchase order and terms. A supplier's shipment declaration or invoice is not warehouse stock. Actual physical custody, inspection, ownership, acceptance and payable recognition are distinct conclusions.
Exclusive manufacture requires the Owner at any amount. The category-specific rights, artwork and sale permission, accountable lead manufacturer, contract, payment terms and quality responsibilities must be supported. Development of a sample can occur under its own specifically authorized stage. Bulk manufacture additionally requires acceptance of the exact applicable sample. Requiring the final approved sample before any sample-development work would be circular.
Actual custody is recordable even when a source document or SKU has not yet been matched. The receiver records what physically arrived, its description, count, location, time and evidence. Manufacturing has an explicit custody-intake action within its existing process family, so it does not need an invented wholesale purchase order. An unknown item remains an observed item, not a fabricated verified SKU. Independent matching and the required ownership and inspection gates still precede accepted owned-stock posting.
Ownership is not the same as physical possession. In the accepted commissioned-apparel example, 92 accepted shirts and eight supplier-owned rejected shirts create 92 owned inventory units. The rejected shirts are not eight owned quarantined units added to a hundred-unit balance. A genuinely owned damaged or recalled unit can instead be part of owned quarantine, under the actual agreement and inspection evidence.
Retail checkout uses eligible available stock. The unpaid physical hold lasts 900 seconds, or fifteen minutes, from authoritative successful hold creation. It is active before its exact expiry and expired at the expiry boundary unless the valid paid conversion has been resolved. An exact retry keeps the original hold identity and expiry; browser refresh does not restart the clock. The implementation must serialize competing payment and expiry outcomes.
Paid demand does not inherit basket expiry. Partial dispatch preserves the unfulfilled paid portions. Picking retains warehouse custody; actual dispatch moves goods into the separate in-transit position. Verified delivery transfers control under the classroom terms and supports the recognized delivered consideration and original issue cost. A shipping label, capture or unverified buyer click does not substitute for that delivery evidence.
If five paid units have two dispatched, three remain in the warehouse paid allocation and two are in transit. A recall can quarantine a physically allocated unit and suspend its sellable allocation while leaving the customer owed one unit. The department must reallocate eligible stock or resolve the remedy. It must not reject the quarantine fact to protect an attractive availability number, or erase the paid demand merely because the unit became unsellable.
The warehouse snapshot uses owned on-hand less owned quarantine less eligible unpaid and paid warehouse allocations. Its physical quantities may be known while final valuation is unavailable. Missing cost does not become zero, and quarantine does not automatically make an accounting value zero. Dispatched goods are not left at their old warehouse; goods in transit retain their separate source and financial identity until the relevant outcome.
Inventory issues retain their original accepted lot and unit cost lineage. FIFO uses accepted chronology and a stable lot tie-break within the SKU and location. The authoritative approved lot total is an integer-centavo amount. Where reviewed equal-unit allocation is supported, 101 centavos across three stable unit ordinals can be 34, 34 and 33. A return uses its original issued cost, not a newly rounded average or today's supplier price. Unresolved freight or another material allocation holds final valuation and margin.
Customer claims are received regardless of amount. A cash refund, approved credit, physically returned goods, inspection, recoverable cost and expected return estimate are separate linked facts. A refund alone cannot restore stock. No-charge replacement delivery retains its original remedy and reviewed cost treatment; it does not require a second revenue-bearing sales line. Pending provider outcomes and chargebacks are reconciled against the original charge so one economic remedy does not become two promised refunds.
Expected returns have supported outstanding refund-liability and recovery-asset positions. When an expectation is realized, the actual credit or recoverable return consumes that expectation. It is not deducted in full again. There is no invented default return rate. Unknown estimation or recovery evidence makes the affected final financial component unavailable until the required review.

### 7. Financial integrity and event history

The baseline uses PHP-only classroom amounts expressed as integer centavos, with UTC evidence instants and Asia/Manila accounting periods. Unsupported currencies are retained or held for appropriate reconciliation; no exchange rate is invented. Any zero simulated tax or royalty belongs only to an illustration that explicitly states it. It is not a universal commercial or legal default.
Budget, commitment, invoice, advance, payable, cash, expense and asset are different quantities. Reserve the full supported related obligation when it becomes authorized and binding. A payment applies against that commitment; it does not consume a second copy of the contract or restore the approved budget. An authorized PHP 40,000 commitment against PHP 100,000 leaves PHP 60,000 available whether PHP 15,000 is settled and PHP 25,000 remains outstanding or no installment has yet been paid.
A project-cap roll-forward includes the initial award. An opening cap of zero plus an initial PHP 100,000 and no amendments closes at PHP 100,000. A PHP 5,000 stage envelope subsequently subsumed by a whole-project PHP 25,000 cap changes the whole cap by PHP 20,000; it is not an additional PHP 25,000 on top of the old envelope.
The accepted Anime prime example has a PHP 240,000 ceiling and a cash schedule of PHP 48,000, PHP 72,000 and PHP 120,000. A final gross invoice of PHP 168,000 less the prior PHP 48,000 advance produces PHP 120,000 final cash. Applying the advance is not another payment. Finance independently classifies supported services, rights, advances, work in progress, ready-to-use assets, amortization and impairment rather than automatically treating every accepted milestone as an expense.
Provider events are retained as facts with original source party, namespace, event and transaction identities, amount, currency, occurrence time and verification evidence. Event kinds are not one replaceable linear status. A late pending or declined notice does not erase a confirmed capture. Exact retries have one effect; distinct events concerning the same economic effect do not manufacture another payment. More than one actual charge is recorded as an actual overcharge requiring reconciliation.
A verified event can be unmatched. Its local checkout, order, payout or remedy binding may legitimately be absent. Preserve the observation without inventing a match or approval. Only the independently matched original obligation and its applicable authority permit a local financial, access or stock effect. The shared Finance entry is a post-matching projection, not a substitute for the unresolved observation.
Corrections retain prior versions and explicit supersession. Full replacement positions are not added together, and signed ledger movements are not substituted for full report positions. A revoked or expired permission stops the affected new action; it does not erase completed work, confirmed cash, a justified customer remedy or another surviving liability.

### 8. Approved reports and analytical interpretation

The baseline contains eight report definitions with 34 measures. Each definition specifies its row meaning, keys, source evidence, cohort, time zone, units, aggregation, correction rule and limitations. Seven report purposes are Central candidates. Actual transmission and publication still require their individual approved purpose, exact content and review; accepting the report design does not approve every future batch. Manufacturing-project reporting remains local in this version.
Manga title engagement has one work, calendar month and declared signed-in reader scope per row. Its measures are reading starts, reading completions, title-distinct readers and completion rate. A completion refers to a counted start and its original cohort. Distinct title accounts cannot be summed across works or months to obtain company-unique people. A zero denominator makes the rate not applicable; it is not a fabricated zero success rate.
Manga advertising settlements has one ad provider, supported settlement month and currency per row. It reports verified ad entitlement, the full earned creator position and the retained position for the declared basis. It uses the selected reconciled statement revision and its complete allocation manifest. It is not a title-profit report, an advertiser-gross estimate or proof that creator cash was paid.
Anime title viewing has one title and start-cohort month per row. It reports starts, completions, unique eligible content seconds, title-distinct viewers and completion rate. Content versions and actual eligible intervals support the counts. It does not allocate subscription revenue to a title or prove a viewer-to-buyer conversion.
Anime subscriptions has one paid offer, accounting month and currency per row in the selected PH/PHP cohort. It distinguishes first verified paid-period starts from later separately paid periods. Confirmed immediate terminations are different from ordinary scheduled expiry. Monthly distinct cancellation accounts are nonadditive across months. The month-end count is a billing-entitlement snapshot, not the number of people able to play every title. Earned access revenue comes from the reviewed service and credit schedule, not captures alone.
Anime content costs has one sourcing path, license or commissioned project, accounting month and currency per row. Outstanding commitments and payables are month-end balances. Recognized expense and confirmed cash paid are period movements. Contract, title and episode relationships retain lineage without repeating the whole project total once per child. Commitment, payable, expense and cash are not summed into one apparent cost.
Merchandise sales has one SKU, accounting month and currency per row. It separates gross delivered units, physically inspected returned units, recognized net sales, matched COGS and gross margin. Actual credit movements and changes in outstanding expected-refund liability affect net sales once. Original issue cost, actual recoverable returns and expected-recovery changes affect COGS once. Final margin is unavailable if a required cost or estimation component is unsupported.
Merchandise inventory has one SKU, warehouse and snapshot day per row. It reports owned on-hand, reserved, quarantine, available quantity and carrying value. These are balances at a defined instant, not flows to sum across dates. The warehouse view does not silently include dispatched stock at its old location or claim to be the entire owned inventory including all in-transit support.
Manufacturing-project reporting has one project, accounting month and currency per row. It separates the month-end authorized cap, effective approved cap-change flow, recognized classified expense and confirmed monthly supplier cash. Initial awards and prior stage envelopes reconcile locally. Project-to-batch or SKU links do not multiply the cap, expense or cash. This eighth report is local-only under version 1.0.
Reports preserve availability separately from freshness. AVAILABLE can contain a true zero. WITHHELD, UNAVAILABLE and NOT_APPLICABLE contain no invented numeric substitute. A stale verified observation is labelled as stale; a failed refresh does not become a current empty result. An approved complete empty replacement has a different meaning from no observation, a privacy-held partition or a failed attempt.
Corrections replace the complete approved partition at a higher retained revision. Old and new full totals are never added. Rates are recalculated from compatible components, not averaged from percentages. Snapshot values, overlapping distinct-account counts, incompatible currencies or scopes, and differently defined measures cannot be freely summed.

### 9. Privacy, access and retention

Reader, subscriber and buyer accounts remain department-scoped. A common email, similar account text or shared IP does not create an approved company customer identity. Staff can hold scoped company roles, but the independent-review restriction still applies. The Owner receives approved aggregates and minimized decision cases rather than unrestricted raw reading, viewing, contact, payment or supplier-bank details.
The accepted classroom small-cohort threshold is ten distinct local accounts. A positive customer-derived cohort below ten has its entire protected row, components and derived rates withheld. A true zero is a different result, still subject to purpose and disclosure review. Complementary totals, overlapping filters, earlier publications and changes over time must not reveal a withheld value by subtraction or differencing.
Metadata can also reveal information. A singleton-work partition may expose a small positive cohort through its existence, row count, digest change or comparison with an earlier release. Where necessary, disclosure review withholds or denies the complete partition or unsafe manifest, rather than publishing a token that implicitly identifies the missing group. A valid typed record alone does not certify privacy.
The retention policy distinguishes six purposes. Raw reading and viewing activity is retained for 90 days from original occurrence. Ordinary account and profile detail is minimized or deleted 30 days after verified closure, subject to separately justified outstanding records. Shipping or return contacts and case correspondence are retained for 90 days after the last related fulfillment or remedy case closes.
Minimized contract, rights, authority, financial and owned-stock lineage uses five calendar years after the later of final obligation closure and agreement or claim expiry. Minimal authentication, access and security diagnostics use 365 days from occurrence. Approved minimized aggregate report revisions and manifests use 24 calendar months from the end of the source period. These are selected classroom durations, not claims that a law prescribes these numbers.
Classify a retained projection by its actual purpose. Financial decision evidence belongs to the financial class even if someone calls it an approval audit. Technical access diagnostics belong to the security class. Raw customer correspondence does not become a five-year financial archive simply because it shares a case number.
A valid hold identifies the case, narrow evidence scope, justification, reviewer and next review date. It restricts access and preserves what is necessary; it does not authorize indefinite retention of every customer's data. The design target is for eligible protected backups to age out within thirty days and for restored systems to reapply deletion and hold instructions before ordinary access. A minimal disposal receipt does not retain the deleted content.
Deleting raw activity limits later reconstruction. A two-year aggregate history does not justify keeping person-linked raw events forever. After permitted erasure, a correction uses only surviving permitted evidence. Unsupported exact distinct-account or finer-grain reconstruction becomes unavailable rather than being invented from totals.
Canonical IP mapping is separately reviewed and versioned. Valid local source records can remain UNMAPPED; an unsupported Central IP slice is unavailable. Multi-IP links are descriptive tags for initial financial analysis. The whole SKU or project value is not repeated for every character or IP, and no weighted financial allocation is introduced in this version. A single independently reviewed exclusive IP can be grouped once.

### 10. Selected demonstration mode

The baseline uses synthetic canonical adapters and clearly fictional records. MOCK_AD_V1 supplies statement revisions and separate attribution and cash evidence. MOCK_PAY_V1 supplies canonical payment and adjustment facts. MOCK_SHIP_V1 supplies physical shipping and delivery evidence. MOCK_MEDIA_V1 supplies placeholder media and access decisions. MOCK_IDENTITY_V1 supplies separate scoped accounts and staff roles. These names define the demonstration boundary; they do not select or imply a real vendor integration.
The mock mode must still respect identity, original obligation, amount, currency, authority, service, custody and correction rules. Dummy data cannot bypass a failed gate, create two effects from one event or contradict its report totals. It must be labelled fictional. Showing an encrypted-media label is not proof of actual DRM, just as showing a paid badge is not proof of a real payment.
This version does not select a database engine, hosting service, identity provider, real payment processor, courier or wire protocol. Those technical choices are made later within the approved meanings. Moving to real data, real payments or actual licensed assets requires its own appropriate authorization, evidence and verification; the classroom freeze does not supply them.

### 11. What downstream artifacts must preserve

A DFD derives from the accepted actors, stores, submissions, outputs and meaningful feedback. The 151 process families are the source inventory, not a requirement to draw 151 boxes on one page. Decomposition must preserve exact boundary meaning and balancing. Use Gane–Sarson conventions, no process-to-process arrows, justified stores, directionally correct flows and meaningful responses to external submissions. Semantic umbrellas require the same real source, direction, destination and business purpose; a shared endpoint alone is insufficient.
The ERDs derive entity identity, relationships, keys and both-end cardinalities from the accepted records and evidence. Separate departmental operational ownership is preserved. A logical record shape need not become exactly one physical table, but its information and constraints must be represented. Native editable Crow's Foot diagrams display attribute names and PK/FK markers only. SQL types and nullability belong in the underlying schema. Unproven relationships and invented tables are not used to make a diagram look connected.
A star model begins with an approved fact grain, source, unit, time and currency. Reading, viewing, service income, delivered-goods income, expense, cash and snapshot balances retain their different meanings. A galaxy model combines several facts through genuinely conformed dimensions, without an unsupported raw customer join or financial allocation. Snowflake normalization uses evidenced dimension hierarchies without changing grain, duplicating totals or manufacturing a Manga ancestry for an unrelated Anime title.
ETL and BI must implement the actual approved source-to-report rules. Central cannot reconstruct events finer than the published departmental grain. Schema validation, source totals, scope, privacy, exact content and per-batch permission are checked before publication. Idempotent correction and freshness reporting are part of correctness, not optional dashboard decoration.
Backend implementation must enforce the accepted actions and state transitions at a trusted boundary. A caller cannot self-approve, assert independent review, revive expired stock or manufacture a provider fact. The implementation must resolve current object and authority scope, retain immutable history, handle safe repeated events and conflicts, and preserve atomicity where competing stock, payment or state changes demand it. Those guarantees require implementation tests; a correct business document does not create them automatically.
Frontend and Figma design derive from the same roles, records, actions and outcomes. Screens must distinguish a request from an approval, an approval from execution, and an observation from a reconciled effect. Empty, pending, denied, correction-required, unavailable, stale and error outcomes need coherent presentation and next actions. Interface choices can improve layout, navigation and components while preserving the baseline. A client-side control must not become the only enforcement of a financial or rights rule.

### 12. Traceability, verification and controlled change

Every derived artifact identifies its governing baseline version and the source IDs it implements. The detailed process, record, action, purpose, type and report catalogues provide those anchors. A design review should be able to follow a screen action to its process and record constraints, its backend behavior, relevant diagram relationship, reporting effect and acceptance case. A changed rule should reveal which of those artifacts needs updating.
The pre-acceptance review passed 411 full specification/reference checks and 169 independently run PA06-focused checks. Ten material issue groups were repaired, including unmatched payment observations, negative intake, native external identity, manufacturing custody and false service-recognition arithmetic. Those are evidence of a bounded review and paper validation. They do not claim that a deployed system, actual source signatures, supplier independence, legal rights, privacy enforcement or complete interactive Figma was tested.
The business freeze now has zero open business blockers within its stated academic scope. The remaining post-freeze obligations are the actual diagrams and design conformance, operational database and application behavior, security and provider/source verification, and departmental OLAP, ETL, warehouse and BI implementation. Completing one of those deliverables must not be inferred from completing another.
A business change begins with a numbered request and reason. Identify the affected baseline and source IDs, assess its diagram, entity, analytical, backend, frontend, data, security and testing impact, and describe any migration or reconciliation consequence. Obtain explicit authorized acceptance for the changed meaning, update all affected artifacts and cases, and publish a new version with an immutable source manifest. Retain the prior baseline so earlier results remain reproducible.
A layout adjustment, implementation detail or other choice that preserves every locked business meaning can be documented within the derived artifact's own version. A change to an offer, threshold, authority stage, rights assumption, sharing rule, record meaning, metric, lifecycle or financial allocation is not merely cosmetic. It follows the business-change procedure. Discovered mistakes are corrected through that procedure; the lock protects consistency while allowing an explicit, reviewable correction.
Approval precedence: D33/D34/D35/D36 and this versioned baseline govern current selected business meanings. Older source terms such as “proposed” or “draft” are historical documentation labels where explicitly superseded by acceptance. Actual workflow DRAFT/PENDING/UNMATCHED states remain valid business states; approval of a definition is never approval of a particular transaction, source claim or export batch.
Completeness convention: the remaining chapters reproduce every unique business property and field control from the 22 frozen sources as labelled contracts, lists and tables. Repeated aliases are cross-referenced. Compatibility and illustrative evidence retain their stated limitations; no JSON source dump is substituted for the specification.

## BUSINESS FOUNDATION

Source: knowledge-system/vault/BUSINESS-FOUNDATION.md

### Loxada Entertainments — company and study foundation


#### Company and introduction

Loxada Entertainments is a fictional entertainment company used for a university Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence study. It manages publishing, subscription streaming and physical merchandise as three independently administered businesses. Each department records its own operations, prepares its own analytics, and shares only approved summaries with the company Owner. The study follows the business evidence from a supplier/customer action to a departmental report and an appropriate company decision.
The project addresses a practical coordination problem: interest in a story or show can support a proposal, but it does not establish copyright permission, a viable investment, available stock, payment or profit. The business plan must preserve those distinctions while giving each participant a clear next step and useful feedback when a request is denied, incomplete or delayed.
The company name is Loxada Entertainments. The repository spelling is an identifier, not another organization. The three departments are Manga & Light Novel, Anime, and Merchandise. There is one Owner / Super Admin. Central governance and BI is a company service operated under scoped roles; it is not a fourth selling department. Four planned interfaces do not mean four operating businesses.

#### Objectives of the study

Describe both supplier paths and one distinct customer offer for each department, with named actors, prerequisites, state changes, records and meaningful feedback.
Demonstrate that rights, independent authority, contracts, accepted work/goods, money and customer remedies remain separately evidenced through ordinary and exceptional cases.
Derive departmental operational records and reporting definitions from those processes, preserving identity, units, periods, source ownership and correction history.
Plan isolated departmental OLTP → local ETL → mart/OLAP and approved aggregate exports → Central warehouse/BI, with reconciled values and explicit limits on comparisons.
Derive role-specific Figma interactions, balanced DFDs, evidenced ERDs and Snowflake/Galaxy fact/dimension models only after the applicable business prerequisites; verify each claimed deliverable against actual artifacts.
Success means that each required scenario has traceable inputs, authority, evidence, outcomes and a reproducible verification case. It does not mean that a document count or passing reference test proves a deployed system. Targets for real revenue, audience growth, supplier performance or production speed are not invented study results.

#### Business offers, suppliers and limits

| Department | Supplier paths | Customer offer | Income and separate costs | Boundary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Manga & Light Novel | Verified independent creators; authorized publisher catalogs with framework and edition grants | One free ad-supported reader for both manga and light novels | Verified agreement-supported advertising entitlement; separate creator shares, publisher fees and operating costs | Publication is not adaptation authority; reads are not money; no customer reading subscription |
| Anime | Acquired completed-title licenses; commissions through one accountable external prime producer per project | One subscription streamer, PHP 200 prepaid for exactly 30 days in the accepted classroom illustration | Plan/service-period earned income; separate license/production assets, services, advances, payables and cash | No cinema, trial, grace, automatic renewal or alternate plan; no subscription money allocated to titles from viewing alone |
| Merchandise | Authorized finished-goods wholesale; exclusive posters/art prints/apparel through one accountable external lead manufacturer per project | One accepted-stock retail storefront | Delivery-based sales; separate issued-lot cost, refunds/credits, production/purchase obligations and expenses | No figures/collectibles, preorders, backorders, COD, dropshipping, internal factory or multi-seller marketplace |

“One prime/lead per project” permits separately contracted projects to use different partners. A replacement/novation within a project is a material controlled change with no ambiguous overlapping accountable lead. A creator can also be a rightsholder, but identity or supplier registration does not prove every permission. The Owner is not the ordinary operator of the three departments.
The accepted case is synthetic PH/PHP under D34, with integer-centavo monetary totals, UTC evidence instants and Asia/Manila report periods. Unsupported commercial terms or legal/tax assumptions are held for review rather than silently defaulted. Actual providers, external agreements, hosting and production integrations are outside the evidence currently verified. Optional data-lake storage is not a fourth system requirement or a substitute for transactional records.

#### Company flow and independent gates

Suppliers submit to the correct department. That department verifies representation, exact subject/scope, rights, financial terms and independent authority.
Department staff execute the permitted sourcing/publication work. A budget approval is not a supplier signature or production notice; a supplier report is not independent acceptance.
The department serves its customer only when current eligibility is proven. Payment, physical dispatch, delivery, earned revenue and returns are distinct stages.
Local records produce reconciled local reports with explicit definitions and source lineage. A local refresh is not permission to export or Central publication.
A department may propose a cross-business opportunity from approved evidence. Central records intake; the Owner separately decides investigation or spending within a specific case and purpose. The receiving department still performs its own rights, contract and execution checks.
Approved aggregate reports may be shared at their declared or coarser grain. Central validates, publishes and reports truthful freshness/unmapped/withheld/unavailable states. It cannot reconstruct customer histories or finer source facts from aggregates.
The Manga → Anime → Merchandise opportunity chain is optional. Acquired Anime may have no Manga ancestor; wholesale goods need not originate in a Loxada production. A canonical IP link describes reviewed identity, not legal permission, customer identity or automatic financial allocation.

#### 1. Proposed academic frame and decision boundary

Recommend fictional PH-only counterparties, PHP-only money in integer centavos, UTC evidence timestamps and Asia/Manila accounting periods, carried forward from the unapproved academic scenario. Reject unsupported currencies; no invented FX. Use synthetic content and parties only. Manga is free/ad-funded, Anime uses one 30-day subscription offer, Merchandise sells posters/art prints and apparel through both selected source paths. Figures, enamel-pin samples and cinema in older example documents are historical test illustrations, outside this selected scenario.
Acceptance of PA03-P2 (research-reviewed revision of P1) authorizes modeling the policy below, not execute agreements, approve the entire D30 scenario, close privacy/data-dictionary findings, merge a PR or start downstream work before gate verification. All money amounts and contract terms below are accepted, invented classroom assumptions. “Proposed/recommendation” labels in the original analysis describe how these rules were developed; D34 governs their accepted use for this project only. Section 7 supplies complete commercial illustrations for all six paths. These terms are recommendations for a fictional case, not inferred real agreements. Any additional sample agreement must state its terms; absent terms produce HOLD rather than defaults.

#### 2. Six source paths: separate agreements and evidence

| Path | Required agreement and clearance | Financial obligation identity | Release/execution evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Manga A: independent creator | Verified fictional creator/rightsholder and signer; title/version-specific digital publication and advertising permission; translation separately where used; editorial acceptance | Signed-example creator agreement names share basis/rate or fixed fee, statement schedule, amendments and termination; no universal share | Cleared grant + accepted manuscript/release version; popularity never grants adaptation |
| Manga B: publisher catalog | Verified publisher authority plus framework and per-title/edition grant; territory, language, format, term and advertising explicitly allowed | Per-title agreement chooses fixed license fee or attributable ad share; minimum guarantees/recoupable royalty advances excluded from this initial case | Matching title/edition grant and accepted delivery; publisher identity alone is insufficient |
| Anime A: completed licensed title | Authorized licensor and explicit episode/title streaming scope, territory, platform and term; QC acceptance | Contract-scoped fixed license obligation and stated service period; no watch-based title revenue | Accepted media + effective streaming grant + subscriber eligibility |
| Anime B: commissioned original/adaptation | One external lead prime-production agreement; original work chain-of-title, or separate exercised adaptation grant for adapted work; produced-work/music/talent clearances and independent streaming grant | Approved project cap, signed milestone amounts/due conditions, accepted deliverables, amendments and cancellation terms; no implied notice to proceed | Owner investment authority + rights clearance + signed prime contract before production; final acceptance and streaming grant before playback |
| Merch A: wholesale | Verified authentic source, lawful resale/distribution evidence and applicable marketing/artwork permissions; supplier agreement and accepted PO | Supplier order/receipt/invoice references and agreed purchase price; no manufacturing obligation | Physical receipt and independent inspection/accepted units; supplier shipment declaration is not stock |
| Merch B: commissioned posters/apparel | One external lead manufacturer; category-specific manufacture, character-art and sale permissions; approved artwork/sample/packaging; quality/compliance responsibilities | Owner-approved project, signed batch price and milestone/payment conditions; tooling/design consideration and accounting classification separately stated; royalty-free synthetic example must explicitly say zero | Cleared exact category + owner authority + signed manufacturing agreement + approved sample before bulk production; accepted physical batch before retail |

Every signed-example agreement needs named fictional parties and authorized signers, department, subject/version, scope, effective dates, currency, consideration/payment basis, deliverables/acceptance, change/cancellation/remedy rules and immutable SIMULATED evidence reference. A draft, received signature request or supplier assertion is not an executed agreement. Title or product identifiers here describe business evidence, not a physical database design.

#### 3. Rights and reviewer rules

Distinct permissions: PUBLISH_DIGITAL, TRANSLATE_DIGITAL, ADAPT_ANIME, STREAM_ANIME, MANUFACTURE_MERCH, USE_CHARACTER_ART, SELL_MERCH. Clearance records identify exact work/edition/episode or poster/apparel class, authorized licensor/signer, evidence version, territory, language, platform/channel, start/end and revocation/dispute status. Do not impose blanket nonoverlap on different valid grants; overlapping contradictory exclusivity is a review conflict.
Effective window is start-inclusive/end-exclusive. Missing, disputed, revoked, not-yet-effective, expired or category-mismatched permission blocks the affected action. Owner, finance, QC or popularity cannot override a rights denial.
Paying for outsourced animation or artwork does not by itself prove copyright ownership. The prime and manufacturer agreements must state the granted/assigned rights and show authority over subcontractor, music, performer and artwork contributions; unresolved chain of title blocks the relevant release.
An adaptation option permits only its explicit option activities; production requires recorded exercise and matching adaptation permission. Streaming permission does not imply manufacture; poster permission does not imply apparel. Authentic wholesale resale requires applicable source/distribution evidence, not an invented universal fresh copyright license.
Rights Reviewer evaluates permission independently of the requesting Admin. Finance Reviewer evaluates obligation/payment independently of its requester. A classroom actor may occupy multiple roles, but the same identity cannot request and independently approve the same restricted case. If separation cannot be demonstrated, HOLD for an independent simulated reviewer; adding a role name does not solve the conflict.
Expiry/revocation stops new affected releases, production or sale and opens a remediation case. Existing inventory, in-progress contracts, subscriber remedies and sold goods require evidence-based handling; do not automatically destroy inventory, erase obligations or revoke every unrelated grant.

#### 4. Proposed authority matrix

| Action | Decision authority | Conditions / failure action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Routine nonexclusive license, wholesale replenishment or ordinary purchase | Department Admin up to and including PHP 50,000 | Current written delegation, correct department/action/currency, within remaining approved budget, independent rights and finance checks; otherwise owner review |
| New Anime commission; new exclusive Merch manufacturing project; exclusive IP grant | Owner at every amount | Admin prepares case; independent rights and finance concurrence, project cap, signed agreement and any sample gates before execution |
| Above PHP 50,000; material scope/exclusivity/rights change; budget increase | Owner | Aggregate related obligations and amendments, not individual split documents; revise authority and contract before incremental commitment |
| Eligible routine retail remedy/refund up to PHP 2,000 inclusive | Merch Admin with independent finance verification | Original paid order, justified remedy and refundable balance; no duplicate refund; requester cannot self-verify payment |
| Above PHP 2,000; fraud/dispute; exceptional loss/refund | Owner + Finance Reviewer | Hold discretionary execution for review; never use internal approval delay to erase mandatory consumer remedies |
| Execute approved payment | Authorized departmental finance/payment role | Approved payable, matching beneficiary/currency/amount, independent verification and current authority; confirmation remains separate from instruction |

Delegation is versioned, department/action/risk/currency scoped, expires after 12 calendar months (or earlier revocation), and is rechecked at commitment and payment. The threshold boundary is exact: PHP 50,000 qualifies only if every routine condition holds; PHP 50,000.01 escalates. Related cases aggregate total exposure, including applicable stated fees/taxes and amendments; amount unknown or relatedness unresolved means HOLD. No spending beyond available approved budget. Owner authorizes strategy and money; reviewers retain independent rights/compliance veto. Feasibility approval permits investigation only; conditional approval does not authorize execution until conditions are independently satisfied.

#### Execution clarifications — top-down review, 2026-10-23

These clarify D34 rather than select new amounts or commercial permissions. Prototype/sample development may proceed only under its specifically authorized contract/stage; bulk manufacture also requires approval of the exact applicable sample. Requiring an approved sample before any sample-development work would be circular.
Each authority case documents the actual related-obligation group and independent grouping evidence: common project/procurement purpose, linked agreement/PO/amendment/renewal and stated fees/taxes. An installment, new document or accounting-year rollover does not reset the same commitment. Same supplier alone does not prove unrelated purchases are one obligation. Unresolved grouping remains HOLD.
Authority has two different clocks. An expired/revoked project decision blocks new or increased commitments under it. It does not erase a valid existing liability. Settling that liability still requires a currently authorized payment operator, independent financial verification, the original commitment/beneficiary and the applicable surviving contractual terms. Payment after expiry is not a renewal or new exposure; a changed beneficiary, increase or settlement concession requires separate review.
The creator 30% illustration is a calculation example, not proof that a zero-upfront variable agreement has zero total exposure. Before binding it, Finance must establish the full related obligation, explicit approved period/formula and any supported maximum/authority envelope. If exposure cannot be bounded under the accepted authority rule, HOLD and request an Owner decision/clarified terms; no unlimited obligation or routine PHP 0 approval is inferred. A future formula/period authority model needs explicit review rather than silently amending D34. Existing lawful accrued obligations remain separately payable under their verified terms.

#### Review clarification: the same commitment consumes authority only once

Reserve the full related contract/PO exposure when it becomes authorized and binding, including stated fees and taxes; check the whole contract against the threshold, never one installment. A payment applies against that same commitment. It neither consumes an extra copy of the contract amount nor restores budget merely because an invoice was settled. Used authority combines settled exposure and the still-outstanding part of the same commitment, counted once, independently of expense recognition.
Example: PHP 100,000 authorized budget and one PHP 40,000 commitment leave PHP 60,000 available. Paying PHP 15,000 changes that commitment to PHP 15,000 settled + PHP 25,000 outstanding; available authority remains PHP 60,000. A confirmed cancellation can release only the documented unperformed obligation after liabilities, termination charges and required approvals are reconciled. A refund request, disputed supplier balance or payment failure does not silently release authority. This is a proposed business rule, not a ledger or concurrent-update implementation.

#### 5. Proposed accounting and settlement rules

These are classroom accounting policies, grounded in existing IAS 2/IFRS 15 research notes, not claims of statutory compliance. Never infer revenue from popularity, payment from an outgoing instruction, accepted goods from an invoice, or expense from a budget.
| Business event | Required evidence and proposed treatment | Kept separate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Manga ad income | Reconciled synthetic provider statement/settlement with reporting period; statement adjustments versioned. Creator share only on agreement-defined net/gross basis and evidenced attributable work amounts | Reads/impressions; provider cash; earned/settled statement amounts; creator payable and payout |
| Manga share example | If attributed eligible basis is PHP 1,000 and signed-example rate is 30%, payable is PHP 300, subject to stated adjustments; figures are an explicit illustration, not a default rate | Unattributed provider income cannot become title-level income or payable; fixed publisher fee is a separate obligation |
| Anime subscription | Captured prepaid consideration remains deferred until the stated access period is delivered; earn over the contractual service period using elapsed UTC duration, exact totals and deterministic last-period rounding | Captures/refunds, entitlement status and earned revenue; subscription income stays plan/service-period, never title-watch allocation |
| License/commission costs | Maintain contract/project financial identity. Supplier advance is an advance until accepted earned milestones; Finance classifies each component before posting: genuine consumed services are expenses; qualifying acquired/commissioned content rights are assets at attributable cost, available-for-use date and finite useful life supported by the agreement. Amortize a ready-to-use fixed-term right over its supported useful life within the grant; review impairment. Production advances remain advances until applied; qualifying accepted production work may be work in progress until usable. If classification/recognition evidence is incomplete, HOLD financial classification instead of automatically expensing or capitalizing | Project budget, commitments, invoices, advances, payable, expense and cash. Service acceptance, legal ownership, asset recognition and cash due are separate conclusions. No episode/title fan-out; internally generated reputation is not automatically an asset |
| Merchandise inventory | One immutable source path per internal SKU; each issue identifies accepted receipt lot(s). FIFO by accepted timestamp then stable lot reference within SKU/location; attributable eligible freight included only with explicit allocation | Quarantined goods; deposits; prototype/tooling/design, royalties, discounts and freight need explicit component classification/allocation; unresolved material components hold final inventory valuation and margin, with any provisional known-cost subtotal clearly labelled |
| Merchandise sale | Under the synthetic delivery-control contract, recognize order-line consideration when independently evidenced delivery transfers control; match issued-lot cost to delivered units. Undelivered dispatched stock retains inventory/in-transit identity | Reservation, payment capture, shipment, delivery, revenue and COGS; partial deliveries recognize only delivered portion |
| Returns/refunds | Link original order/issue/payment. Separate cash refund, customer credit/revenue adjustment, returned physical goods inspection and eligible inventory/COGS recovery; damaged goods are not restored as sellable automatically | Expected returns also require separate estimation of refundable consideration and recoverable goods value before actual cash refund. A credit may adjust revenue without physical restock; damaged units need loss/valuation treatment |
| Cash movements | Only verified synthetic provider/bank confirmation marks paid/refunded; reconcile event ID, amount, currency, payee, original obligation and prior reversals | Instruction, pending response, failed/unknown response, chargeback and final confirmed balance |

Inventory is reviewed against estimated recoverable selling value after completion/sale costs; losses and write-downs are separate from quantities available for sale. Quarantine does not automatically mean zero accounting value. The illustration below expressly leaves rejected units with the supplier; a different ownership/risk agreement requires a different valuation.
Manga statement verification remains the project's evidence gate under D12, but statement period, service earned, receivable and cash settlement are separate. An unverified estimate is not posted as confirmed income. The signed advertising agreement must identify whether Loxada supplies the advertising service or earns a net platform share; no automatic gross advertising revenue.
Sample contracts state prices, attribution/share terms, milestone schedule, refund basis and any fees explicitly. Baseline illustrations use zero simulated tax/royalty only where explicitly written; do not claim zero is legally applicable. Missing jurisdiction/tax terms blocks a complete case. Foreign currency, FX, guarantees/advances with recoupment, complex royalties and unsupported indefinite-life content valuations are excluded from this initial financial case and require a separately approved amendment.
Illustration aligned to selected scope: wholesale poster lot A has 2 units at PHP 100 and lot B has 2 at PHP 120. Three delivered units at PHP 180 generate PHP 540 revenue and PHP 320 FIFO COGS. Remaining lot B unit costs PHP 120. Returning one originally issued lot-A unit creates a separate inspected-return decision; refund confirmation alone cannot increase stock. Commissioned apparel has 100 received, 92 accepted and 8 quarantined: accepted stock is 92, with rejected-unit claims and supplier credit resolved separately. These are paper examples, not executed ledger entries or stock tests.

#### 7. Six filled commercial illustrations — recommendation, not signed contracts

All parties and IDs below are fictional. Proposed agreement window is 2027-01-01 00:00 Asia/Manila through 2028-01-01 00:00 Asia/Manila, start-inclusive/end-exclusive; procurement delivery/payment schedules below are separate from the rights window. Every permission is PH-only; English digital content uses Loxada's web reader/player only, no download, cinema, translation or sublicensing unless separately granted. Physical goods use Loxada's PH retail channel. All examples explicitly have zero simulated tax, shipping surcharge and royalty beyond the stated consideration; this is a classroom simplification, never a tax exemption claim. Each uses distinct simulated requester, rights reviewer, finance reviewer and authorized approver, with no new operating department.
| Sample | Filled business terms | Review and accounting outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SYN-P3-MA: independent creator | Fictional Saltwind creator supplies one English digital work and publication/ad permission. No upfront fee; 30% of independently attributed verified net platform settlement for that work, after only documented platform adjustments. Monthly statement; pay undisputed creator balance within 15 calendar days of verification. Platform statement explicitly reports Loxada's net entitlement, not advertiser gross billings | PHP 1,000 attributable basis -> PHP 300 creator payable and PHP 700 before other costs; keep income, payable and cash separate. No attributed settlement -> no inferred work share. Rights approval remains independent of a PHP 0 upfront price |
| SYN-P3-MB: publisher catalog | Fictional Harbor Publisher grants one named English edition for free ad-supported reading for 12 months. Fixed PHP 12,000, no revenue share/minimum guarantee/recoupment. Due within 15 days of accepted licensed delivery and effective grant; no automatic renewal | Routine Admin authority only with verified PHP 12,000 exposure, delegation and available budget; Finance records qualifying finite licensed right and PHP 1,000 per complete contractual month in this equal-month illustration. Cash due does not determine publication permission |
| SYN-P3-AA: completed Anime | Fictional Meteor licensor supplies one 12-episode title, PH web-stream permission for the stated 12-month term, accepted media and a fixed PHP 120,000 fee. Due within 15 days of accepted effective delivery. No Manga predecessor required | Owner approval above routine threshold; qualifying available licensed right is PHP 120,000, amortized PHP 10,000 per complete equal contractual month in this illustration. Subscriber revenue remains separate from title cost |
| SYN-P3-AB: commissioned Anime | One fictional prime producer, a separately cleared Saltwind adaptation and produced-work streaming scope. Approved production ceiling PHP 240,000; 20% refundable advance, 30% on accepted intermediate package, 50% on accepted final cleared package. The 20% advance is applied against the final contract invoice; total cash cannot exceed PHP 240,000. Milestone invoices show prior applications, so no duplicate advance payable | PHP 48,000 + PHP 72,000 + PHP 120,000 cash schedule. Owner approval at any price, then independent rights/finance review. Qualifying production cost stays contract-scoped work in progress until available; expected benefit/rights/measurement review precedes capitalization. No streaming until final QC and permission; subcontractors remain the prime's responsibility under an express, limited production-only subcontract permission and contribution-rights evidence, not unrestricted public distribution/sublicensing |
| SYN-P3-RA: wholesale posters | Fictional authorized wholesaler: first batch 2 posters at PHP 100; second batch 2 at PHP 120. Supplier retains rejected units/risk until warehouse acceptance; accepted goods payable within 15 days, no advance. Retail price PHP 180 each, immediate confirmed payment then delivery under the separate customer terms | Three delivered posters -> PHP 540 revenue, PHP 320 issued FIFO cost, PHP 120 remaining stock cost. Routine approval checks related PHP 440 total exposure, not just one PO. No defective stock made sellable by an invoice |
| SYN-P3-RB: commissioned apparel | One fictional lead manufacturer; separate PH apparel manufacture/art/sale grant at explicitly zero simulated royalty, with approved sample and no separately billed tooling. Order 100 shirts at PHP 250 per accepted shirt, PHP 25,000 cap. PHP 5,000 refundable advance, remaining accepted-goods balance within 15 days of warehouse acceptance. Defective rejected units stay supplier-owned, unpaid and require replacement or cancellation reconciliation | If 92 accepted and 8 rejected, accepted invoice PHP 23,000; apply PHP 5,000 advance -> PHP 18,000 balance. Eight rejected units are not Loxada inventory in this agreement. New exclusive project still needs owner approval despite being below PHP 50,000. A changed unit price/quantity or missing royalty term requires amendment review |

Shared subscriber illustration: fixed PHP 200 for exactly 30 days (an invented offer, replacing the earlier merely illustrative PHP 199 for this packet only), paid before service; no trial, automatic renewal or grace in this limited example. Ten fully provided days -> PHP 66.67 earned, PHP 133.33 remaining liability under centavo half-up rounding; at the final instant true-up guarantees total PHP 200, never PHP 200.01. Mere payment does not make blocked/unavailable streaming a delivered service. Service loss opens a credit/refund review; consumer law applicability is assessed separately from the retail goods rules.
Shared retail example terms: pay only for accepted available stock; delivery-confirmed transfer of control; no preorders/backorders/COD. Defective, misdescribed or lost goods enter remedy review; optional change-of-mind returns are distinct from required remedies. Log the customer's claim immediately regardless of refund amount. Proposed internal targets are acknowledgement within one business day and escalation of unresolved claims by day three; these are service targets, not fabricated legal deadlines. Amounts above PHP 2,000 trigger internal owner/finance routing, never automatic rejection or forfeiture of customer rights. Replacement, return collection and refund expenses are recorded separately, with no double refund.
All grants are demonstrated with a SIMULATED document, named authorized signer, version, precise subject/category, grant dates and independent clearance. All actual signatures remain absent. On a rights dispute, stop affected new use and review remedies; on cancellation, reconcile completed work, unearned advances and credits under the specific agreement, rather than erase the contract history.
BASELINE PRECEDENCE NOTE: The research dates and source observations remain provenance. References to proposed classroom choices in this archived section do not mean those selected choices are still undecided: D34 and the scoped D35/D36 acceptance govern the current baseline. No real legal rights or compliance proof is created.

#### 8. Research review and corrections — checked 2026-10-22

| Source and observation | Decision for this proposal | Scope/limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| WIPO copyright FAQ (https://www.wipo.int/en/web/copyright/faq-copyright): translation/adaptation and licensing have distinct permission questions | Keep work, medium, territory, product class and permission evidence separate; do not infer rights from a shared IP label | Our permission labels and fictional agreements are project design choices |
| Philippine IP Code, WIPO Lex consolidated edition, s178.4 (https://www.wipo.int/wipolex/en/legislation/details/18399): commissioned work ownership and copyright are not interchangeable | Require written produced-work/artwork terms and contribution clearance; payment receipt alone cannot prove streaming/manufacturing rights | Read the consolidated provision; no claim that this generic checklist decides every audiovisual authorship issue |
| IFRS Foundation IFRS 15 overview (https://www.ifrs.org/issued-standards/list-of-standards/ifrs-15-revenue-from-contracts-with-customers/): revenue follows the promised goods/services and control, not simply cash receipt | Separate subscriber access earned, retail delivery and verified ad entitlement from cash; review returns/adjustments | Our exact prices, evidence gates and equal-duration progress choices are fictional contract assumptions |
| IFRS Foundation IAS 2 overview (https://www.ifrs.org/issued-standards/list-of-standards/ias-2-inventories/): cost composition, cost formulas, sale-linked expense and recoverable value matter | Track lot costs, classify additional costs, review damaged stock/write-downs; do not mark unallocated-cost margin final | Accepted-unit availability is different from ownership/value; specific supplier-risk clause is essential |
| IFRS Foundation IAS 38 overview (https://www.ifrs.org/issued-standards/list-of-standards/ias-38-intangible-assets/): qualifying rights may be assets; useful life and impairment matter | Correct P1's automatic milestone-expense simplification: classify services, advances, acquired rights and qualifying production before posting | No blanket claim that every commissioned cost qualifies as an asset |
| DTI defective-goods guidance (https://fairtrade.dti.gov.ph/faq/is-no-return-no-exchange-policy-allowed/) and RA 11967, ss3/25/26 (https://lawphil.net/statutes/repacts/ra2023/ra_11967_2023.html): remedies and complaint escalation cannot be replaced by a blanket no-return rule; online media content is excluded from this Act's coverage | Preserve retail complaint/remedy rights regardless of internal refund cap; do not apply the goods Act automatically to Manga/Anime media | No universal return-window or tax exemption invented. Judiciary page returned 502 on direct open; statute was read via Lawphil and cross-checked with official judiciary search/DTI material |

These sources support the distinctions, not our PHP limits, sample fees, 12-month delegation or fictional territories. Those remain explicit proposed classroom choices. P1's earlier paper cases above remain the starting review; additions/corrections follow. No copyrighted supplier assets or real agreements were obtained.
