Invariants:
Rights holder or distributor permission is verified at title, territory, medium and time, not inferred from a studio credit.
Playback requires BOTH a valid subscriber entitlement and a current licensed title grant plus QC-approved media.
Playback is denied when required rights, subscription status, catalog policy or media acceptance are unknown.
Financial licensor obligations and subscriber payments are distinct; neither implies title-level subscription revenue.
Subscriber view counts do not prove paid receipts; approved marts preserve defined title or plan grain.
Duplicate licensor invoice, upload or provider event cannot create additional liabilities or entitlements.
Central BI receives only approved aggregated mart data and shared IP identifiers, never raw subscriber identity.
Acquired anime need not correspond to a Manga title already published by Loxada.
Any subscription cancellation, refund, rights expiry and file replacement retains verifiable state history.
No irreversible production start without explicit exercised adaptation rights or original-work chain of title, owner investment approval, signed prime contract and notice to proceed.
Prime producer coordinates subcontractor studios and freelancers; Anime Admin owns only one accountable external supplier relationship.
Versioned prime production change orders cannot increase authorized budget or schedule unless approved by delegated authority.
Milestone QC acceptance and intellectual-property rights clearance are separate gates before shared streaming.
Commissioning project cost, milestone invoices, accepted deliverables and subscriber revenue are separate business records with declared grain.
Exact paid-through expiry is a local current-time predicate and does not depend on an expiry callback arriving.
Provider arrival order never by itself establishes current economic or entitlement state; actual confirmed money facts are retained even while discretionary remedy/authority review is pending.
AN-PREPAID-P1 repeat-purchase/activation behavior is a concrete PROPOSED classroom interpretation, not silently accepted new offer terms.
Unique delivered content-position coverage per attempt is not elapsed real-time viewing duration; no wall-clock watch hours inferred from coverage at different playback rates.

Historical review declaration (adoption status superseded by D35/D36): D33/D34 applied; explicit business-step clarification remains DRAFT_SPEC, not a real contract, source/route parity or runtime proof. Provider/timeout/privacy choices are not promoted to ACTIVE.

Transaction boundary: Produce one local source-through-time report revision with separate flow/snapshot reconciliation and exact scope; no database/ETL/BI runtime or authorized Central publication claimed.

Invariants:
Only authorized sourced goods with accepted receipt and inspection create sellable inventory.
Purchase order approval, supplier payables, goods receipt, retail payment, customer shipment and revenue recognition are distinct events.
Available stock equals owned physical on-hand minus owned quarantined minus eligible unpaid/paid allocations, never less than zero; suspended unfulfillable paid demand is preserved separately, not silently cancelled.
Stock reservation and fulfillment must use atomic ACID inventory locking or an equivalent atomic conditional DB update for real concurrency; reference-only unit tests are not a substitute.
Duplicate receipts, payments, stock movements, refunds and carrier events cannot post multiple financial or inventory changes.
Customer paid checkout does not imply customer control transferred or IFRS 15 recognized revenue.
Returned item is not restocked until actually inspected and accepted.
Buyer, supplier, Admin, finance and courier each receive authorization-limited feedback and access.
SKU and GTIN distinguish product variants but cannot prove genuine licensed origin.
Inventory snapshot values are not additive over successive dates; central BI receives vetted monthly aggregates, not buyers' shipping data.
Manufacturing requires distinct character merchandising rights and original chain of title where relevant; an Anime streaming right never authorizes merchandise.
Lead manufacturer is one accountable contracted external supplier who manages its own factories and subcontractors.
Owner approval, signed manufacturing services contract, licensed IP/approved artwork and exact creative brief precede notice to proceed.
Prototype approval is distinct from receiving compliant physically accepted finished batch units into sellable SKU inventory.
Signed approved change orders control price scope tooling timeline and compliance revision.
Manufacturing advances and royalties, inventoried landed costs, recognized expenses, supplier paid cash and buyer revenue require distinct original records and accounting grain.
Project-month authorized budget is a nonadditive snapshot; manufacturer batch acceptances are SKU and batch-grained.
MR-S07 picking/packing retains warehouse ownership/allocation; only verified MR-S08 actual handover moves exact owned issue quantity/value to in-transit and consumes that allocation segment. MR-S09 supported delivery controls sales/COGS recognition.
Partial consumption/release/suspension uses disjoint original-allocation quantity history; carrier refusal, recall and cancellation cannot fabricate stock or erase paid customer demand.
Custody quantities include supplier-held rejects, but owned inventory/value includes only evidenced Loxada-owned portions; D34 rejects remain supplier-owned in its stated sample.
Lot total integer-centavo cost plus approved quantity/basis is authoritative. Approved equal-unit allocation uses stable unit positions for deterministic remainder conservation; no rounded integer unit rate may create or destroy cost.
Expected-return estimate/refund-liability/recovery-value accounting remains distinct from actual returned units, cash credits/refunds, sellable stock and replacement expenses.
Pending refunds, chargebacks, failed/reversed refunds and any excess external reimbursement reconcile to original payment/case. Fraud/dispute/exceptional loss/refund requires independent Owner plus Finance regardless of the routine refund amount limit.

Keep rights grant state independent; a reviewed mapping change never rewrites source contracts or creates multi-IP weights.
Allowed result states:
ACTIVATED; CONFLICTED; UNMAPPED; NEEDS_CORRECTION
Next actions:
Send purpose-specific mapping notice to each affected department Steward and record actual receipt separately from local apply.; Review affected dataset/permission revisions before any republication through CG-13..16; tell the Owner when comparisons remain unavailable or stale.
Exception cases:
Same display name or unverified rights relationship is the only evidence: hold mapping.; Conflicting effective intervals or unsupported multi-IP allocation: retain source-local totals and no duplicated whole financial values.; Department records notice only: do not claim local remapping or historical report replacement succeeded.
Source evidence:
CENTRAL-GOVERNANCE-OPERATIONS#CG-15; PA-03-CONTRACT-POLICY (D34); PA-05-BUSINESS-HANDOFFS; CENTRAL-BI-CONTRACTS
Historical review declaration (adoption status superseded by D35/D36): Steward-owned source identity review; D35 selects descriptive multi-IP tags and source-grain financials without weighted allocation initially; source mapping still requires independent evidence.
Current adoption: the selected business definition is accepted under baseline 1.0. Requirements for actual source evidence, independent authority, case/batch approval and technical verification remain binding.
Transaction boundary: Record one reviewed mapping revision and notices. Activation, receiver acknowledgment, impact review and governed report restatement are distinct effects.
Predecessor rule: Use the actual mapping review from CG-04 or the same subject's retained prior reviewed mapping. No popularity opportunity or all source departments are required. Missing evidence/conflicts are recordable outcomes; verified authority is needed for activation.
Authority purpose refs: Empty list; no entries.

#### Business contract

Trigger: An accepted batch is ready for governed publication or a complete corrected-partition replacement.
Predecessor process ids:
CG-14
Entry checks:
Recheck exact permission and its scope/expiry/revocation, validated source revision and current mapping/definition compatibility at publication.
Validate full declared replacement scope and lineage; empty replacement must explicitly mean removal/withholding/no-data as applicable rather than invented zero.
Keep zero, unavailable, withheld and not-applicable visible states distinct; do not publish unsafe metadata.
Allowed result states:
PUBLISHED; HELD; FAILED; ROLLED_BACK
Next actions:
Record actual publication revision/superseded partition only when committed and return separate publication outcome to the source department.; Update truthful source through-time, revision and freshness for CG-17; failed refresh retains prior authorized output visibly stale or withheld as required.
Exception cases:
Permission expired/revoked after validation: hold publication and require a new actual permission where appropriate.
Out-of-order/conflicting correction, incomplete replacement or interrupted publication: preserve last authorized state and record held/failure/rollback outcome.
Same immutable accepted publication retry: one logical effect; never add replacement totals to prior totals.
Source evidence:
CENTRAL-GOVERNANCE-OPERATIONS#CG-16; PA-03-CONTRACT-POLICY (D34); PA-05-BUSINESS-HANDOFFS; CENTRAL-BI-CONTRACTS

Current adoption: the selected business definition is accepted under baseline 1.0. Requirements for actual source evidence, independent authority, case/batch approval and technical verification remain binding.
Transaction boundary: Future implementation must commit one complete allowed partition replacement and its publication lineage together or expose no partial success. This business requirement is not a database-transaction proof.
Predecessor rule: Only publication requires this exact batch's accepted CG-14 validation and current permission. Held/failed attempt recording remains possible when checks fail; unrelated batches or an incident are not predecessors to ordinary valid publication.

#### Business contract

Trigger: Owner requests an authorized company dashboard, comparison or evidence-backed recommendation.
Predecessor process ids:
CG-16
Entry checks:
Resolve actual Owner/purpose permission and each source report period/revision/availability/through-time; a request for unavailable data may return a truthful unavailable result.
Aggregate each source fact separately to compatible headers before comparison; distinct accounts, ratios and snapshots obey their documented nonadditivity.
Preserve source accounting meanings/currencies and no raw customer joins, invented title subscription revenue or causal viewer-to-buyer conversion.
Allowed result states:
AVAILABLE; PARTIAL; STALE; WITHHELD; UNAVAILABLE; NOT_APPLICABLE; DENIED
Next actions:
Return only permitted values with compatible grain, definitions, availability and provenance; show limitations instead of guessed zeros.; Human may create a new CG-02/09 opportunity from valid evidence; query/recommendation never signs a deal or initiates spending.
Exception cases:
Unsupported sum of monthly snapshots, per-title distinct accounts or mixed source money: reject that interpretation and show safe separate views.
Underlying mapping or required source is withheld/unavailable/stale: display the limitation without leaked totals or fabricated cross-IP rows.
Recommendation lacks named method, source period or uncertainty/evaluation: label as an unsupported draft and do not grant action authority.
Source evidence:
CENTRAL-GOVERNANCE-OPERATIONS#CG-17; PA-03-CONTRACT-POLICY (D34); PA-05-BUSINESS-HANDOFFS; CENTRAL-BI-CONTRACTS
Historical review declaration (adoption status superseded by D35/D36): Governed company analytics service only; candidate extra KPIs/forecasts require their own definitions and release review, not automatic promotion from a draft note.
Current adoption: the selected business definition is accepted under baseline 1.0. Requirements for actual source evidence, independent authority, case/batch approval and technical verification remain binding.
Transaction boundary: Record the query and authorized result/provenance. A read or recommendation has no operational commitment, rights or financial effect.
Predecessor rule: CG-16 supplies the actual source publications being queried, individually as available. Missing/withheld/failed sources return truthful partial/unavailable results; no requirement to manufacture publications from all departments or incidents before any query.

Actor: GOVERNANCE_REVIEWER

Exception: Retain scoped incident, evidence and independent corrective decision; restrict affected action, preserve audit/rights/financial history and never mark an unresolved exception closed.

#### Business contract

Trigger: Governance reviewer receives an incident or a purpose-specific department request requiring nonroutine Owner/Finance handling.
Predecessor process ids:
CG-01
Entry checks:
Use the exact named authority_purpose_refs from PA-05-AUTHORITY-HANDOFFS: distinct Manga commitment/exclusive/renewal/cancellation, department-specific AUTHORITY_CLARIFICATION, MERCH_CUSTOMER_REMEDY_EXCEPTION, MERCH_STOCK_LOSS_EXCEPTION and ANIME_SUBSCRIBER_REMEDY_AUTHORITY cases. No unregistered alias is interchangeable with them; bind original department/case/purpose/revision.
For Manga nonroutine/exclusive/above-limit commitments, review full related exposure and current budget plus independent rights/Finance findings; intake is not adaptation feasibility.
For Merch refunds above PHP 2,000 or fraud/dispute/exceptional cases, require original local remedy/payment obligation references, independently verified remaining refundable amount and Finance finding; send no raw customer identity, address, payment credentials or provider payload centrally.
For Anime subscriber remedies, do not import the retail PHP2,000 delegation. Missing exact media terms/current authority holds discretionary execution for Owner/Finance clarification. Independently verified provider cash/refund/chargeback facts are still recorded locally and reconciled, not delayed or erased by pending internal approval.
Resolve actual independent Owner and Finance decision authority; governance intake/reviewer cannot self-approve the requesting department case.
Allowed result states:
RECEIVED
NEEDS_CORRECTION
UNDER_REVIEW
APPROVED
CONDITIONAL
RETURNED
DECLINED
DEFERRED
SUSPENDED
RESOLVED
ESCALATED
Next actions:
Record actual purpose-specific intake feedback, then independent Owner/Finance decision separately; send the read-only case-bound outcome back to the original local department receiver and record actual receipt.
Department performs its own commitment/payment/remedy under current operator authority and reports real confirmation; Central never executes supplier or buyer cash.
Route only the named existing-case amendment/novation/termination purposes assigned to CG-11 there; MANGA_CANCELLATION_SETTLEMENT remains purpose-specific CG-18 intake/decision plus CG-12 outcome. Use CG-01 for current scoped operators/allocation. Preserve distinct local financial execution and incident closure.
Exception cases:
Same original case/purpose/revision/content repeats: same handling effect; changed content/wrong department/wrong decision stage: hold conflict, never rebind authority.
Requester/Owner same identity in a restricted case, missing Finance review or ambiguous exposure/refundable balance: hold discretionary execution and promptly obtain independent lawful handling; never erase a mandatory remedy.
Original decision expired but lawful debt/refund obligation remains: preserve obligation and arrange a currently authorized operator; no fresh investment approval is fabricated to pay the same debt.
Investigation marked closed with unresolved claim, payment uncertainty or corrective condition: retain open/escalated state, narrow evidence hold and named next reviewer.
Source evidence:
CENTRAL-GOVERNANCE-OPERATIONS#CG-18; PA-03-CONTRACT-POLICY (D34); PA-05-BUSINESS-HANDOFFS; PA-05-AUTHORITY-HANDOFFS
Historical review declaration (adoption status superseded by D35/D36): D34 accepted spending/refund/independent-review requirements. These are named subactivities of existing CG-18, not interchangeable messages, new process IDs, final routes or authority to collect real personal data.
Current adoption: the selected business definition is accepted under baseline 1.0. Requirements for actual source evidence, independent authority, case/batch approval and technical verification remain binding.
Transaction boundary: Record minimized exception intake, independent decision, outbound notice/local receipt and later closure as separate case-bound effects. Any departmental payment/stock/legal action retains its own source truth.
Predecessor rule: Incident, Manga commitment/renewal/cancellation, department authority clarification, Merch customer remedy/stock-loss OR Anime subscriber remedy is its own bounded trigger. Look up CG-01 policy as relevant; absence permits recorded intake/denial and clarification while blocking unsupported discretionary authority. The exact purpose-to-family mapping controls.
Authority purpose refs:
MANGA_COMMITMENT; MANGA_EXCLUSIVE_GRANT; MANGA_RENEWAL; MANGA_CANCELLATION_SETTLEMENT; MERCH_CUSTOMER_REMEDY_EXCEPTION; MERCH_STOCK_LOSS_EXCEPTION; MANGA_AUTHORITY_CLARIFICATION; ANIME_AUTHORITY_CLARIFICATION; MERCH_AUTHORITY_CLARIFICATION; ANIME_SUBSCRIBER_REMEDY_AUTHORITY
Supporting roles:
DEPT_ADMIN; SUPER_ADMIN; FINANCE_REVIEWER; RIGHTS_REVIEWER
Authority note: Governance Reviewer owns minimized purpose-specific intake and incident handling; restricted commitment/refund authority is independently recorded by actual Owner/Finance roles, never inferred from the intake actor.
Invariants:
Exactly one owner role and three commerce/content departments; Central BI is a company service and not a fourth operating business.
Owner investment approval never grants adaptation streaming or character merchandise legal rights.
Delegated department thresholds, rights clearance and financial obligations have independent authorization.
Cross-department feasibility recommendations do not automatically create licenses, payables, production notices or purchase orders.
Central warehouse receives approved aggregation and conformed dimension keys; raw subscriber reader buyer PII is denied by default.
Original source fact grain is never made finer in central export; source metric definitions are preserved.
IP crosswalk must be verified with evidence; title string equality or viewer email is insufficient.
Title-unique reader or viewer counts and budget or inventory snapshots are nonadditive across titles/time.
Plan-period subscriptions do not attribute earnings to individual Anime titles without approved separate method.
Monthly aggregate facts must not be directly fact-joined to many-to-many other monthly facts and multiplied.
Export batch id/revision/checksum and canonical source reconciliation are required for idempotent ETL.
Approval statuses and BI correctness flags are auditable with corrective revision lineage.
Manga advertising revenue, Anime subscription revenue and Merchandise recognized sales revenue have distinct measurement and currency/accounting bases and cannot be summed without explicit reconciliation policy.

### Reuse registry

Financial:
pa06_source_records.json#AdStatementEntitlement; pa06_source_records.json#CreatorShareAllocation; pa06_source_records.json#DepartmentFinanceEntry
Reading:
pa06_source_records.json#ReadingAttempt
Reporting:
pa06_report_definitions.json#manga_title_engagement_monthly; pa06_report_definitions.json#manga_ad_settlements_monthly
Central reports:
pa06_coordination_records.json#MANGA_EXPORT_PERMISSION; pa06_coordination_records.json#MANGA_REPORT_BATCH; pa06_coordination_records.json#MANGA_REPORT_RESULT; pa06_coordination_records.json#MANGA_MAPPING_NOTICE
Candidate:
CandidateSubmission; CandidateIntakeResult; FeasibilityDecisionProjection; FeasibilityDecisionReceipt; held_manga_compatibility: semantic mapping only, no exact wire parity or MG-S11/route adoption
Operation rules:
All38 existing source families now reference explicit local operations. A family actor is not authority to perform every supplier/service/reviewer subactivity.
Action fields are an exact submitted/generated partition. required_submitted_fields plus conditional_input_rules define request shape; record_lifecycles defines persisted draft/readiness validity. Generated fields are forbidden client inputs.
Resolve actor/object/independence/current authority from trusted provenance. Body IDs/role labels and reference possession never grant access or approval.
Shared/path aliases delegate to the same original record/action effect; no duplicate stores, applications, grants, liabilities, transfers or report rows are created to connect aliases.
Original event/case/terms/content/version and correction lineage remains immutable. Exact repeated command has one effect; changed same-revision content conflicts. Unknown delivery/result is not success.
Third-party rights notice may be received before proved authority; independent review determines affected scope/urgency and disposition. A complaint or creator withdrawal request is not automatic restriction, rights clearance or debt deletion.
Real provider/auth/signature/storage/age-region enforcement and final wire parity remain unimplemented. Canonical logical intake records are not actual external-provider API schemas.
The shared proposed logical type registry supplies nested descriptor shapes. D35 and all records here remain unapproved classroom proposals; no personal-data collection or Central release is authorized.
Local reader guest/own-account actions, supplier signatures/changes/disputes, provider intake/reconciliation and Owner feasibility projection are distinct actor-scoped operations.
No new process ID, route, final Figma/DFD/ERD, database or runtime claim follows from this dictionary coverage.
Successor verification obligations:
Derive and verify technical designs/physical keys/protocols and implementations against this accepted baseline; retain independent actual source/case/batch evidence and authorization.
Instance-specific missing terms, rights, attribution, cost or provider facts still produce the specified HOLD/UNAVAILABLE; business acceptance does not fabricate them.

### Guard definitions

ROLE_SCOPE_VERIFIED: Resolve actual principal and allowed operation from trusted provenance; never accept a role/body claim as authority.
ORIGINAL_OBJECT_SCOPE_VERIFIED: Resolve actual original own/delegated object/case/revision. An arbitrary other-ID request never changes or reveals that object.
INDEPENDENT_REVIEWER_VERIFIED: Actual reviewer identity and scope are independent of the original restricted requester; another role label on the same identity is insufficient.
AUTHENTICATED_OWN_ACCOUNT: Actual local authenticated account and own target verified; anonymous reading permission does not grant own-data changes.
ALL_REQUIRED_SIGNATURES_VERIFIED: Every required exact-version signature and capacity independently verified, with complete reviewed signer requirements.
RIGHTS_CLEARANCE_VERIFIED: Actual exact work/edition/scope/time independent permission is current; Owner/money/editorial approval cannot supply copyright.
FINANCIAL_AUTHORITY_VERIFIED: Actual D34 full-related exposure, independent financial review, available authority/budget and current decision/conditions verified.
MINIMUM_NOTICE_SCOPE_ACCEPTED: Minimally sufficient allegation/target/context passes safe intake/abuse handling; it is not authenticated copyright ownership or a restriction decision.
PROVIDER_SOURCE_VERIFIED: Actual contracted provider origin and original event evidence independently verified under a reviewed mapping; no real protocol/provider is assumed.
APPROVED_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_VERIFIED: Exact independent approved original obligation, unpaid balance, beneficiary and amount verified; duplicate instructions cannot exceed it.
CURRENT_PAYMENT_AUTHORITY_VERIFIED: Current operator authority and independent original payable/payment verification; project-decision expiry does not erase a valid surviving debt.
TRANSFER_HISTORY_VERIFIED: Authoritative original transfer, amount/currency/payee and effective event/reversal lineage reconciled; arrival order or screenshot is insufficient.
VERIFIED_LOCAL_REPORT_SCOPE: Original report cutoff/revision/grain/cohort/definition and purpose-cleared aggregate evidence independently verified.
CENTRAL_SOURCE_VERIFIED: Actual Central governance source/principal and original message independently verified; not an untrusted department/body assertion.
ORIGINAL_CANDIDATE_BINDING_VERIFIED: Match persisted original candidate message, Central case where established, source candidate/work, purpose, revision and content; never rebind from received body.
OWNER_DECISION_AUTHORITY_VERIFIED: Read actual independently committed Owner feasibility decision/version and legitimate supersession; no local rewritten outcome.
OWN_IDENTITY_CONTEXT_VERIFIED: Actual own local identity context under reviewed purpose, not raw passwords/credentials or a cross-department identity merge.
ACCOUNT_VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE_VERIFIED: Actual local identity/account verification and original request independently resolved; no specific auth technology is selected.
APPLICABLE_DATA_POLICY_VERIFIED: Actual scoped purpose/access/retention/hold and required review authority; D35 proposal alone is insufficient.
SUPPLIER_CAPACITY_VERIFIED: Actual original applicant/supplier/representative capacity and collision-review evidence independently verified; not proof of copyright or canonical cross-company IP identity.

### Cross record constraints


#### MC-01

Id: MC-01
Rule: Verified supplier/source party and signatures/authority are required for agreement execution and grants; own application-bound drafting does not imply them.

#### MC-02

Id: MC-02
Rule: Every release/grant/assent/editorial/moderation reference resolves to the exact original source object/content revision; source or local record IDs cannot be rebound from input.

#### MC-03

Id: MC-03
Rule: Effective intervals use start-inclusive/end-exclusive instants with start < end. Current release scope is inside applicable signed grant scope and original terms.

#### MC-04

Id: MC-04
Rule: MANGA_COMMITMENT/MANGA_MATERIAL_CHANGE/MANGA_BUDGET_CHANGE authority purposes remain distinct from feasibility. Approval/proposal/recognized obligation/cash have different effects.

#### MC-05

Id: MC-05
Rule: Unknown exposure/rounding/attribution stays HOLD; a fresh allocation or event ID cannot duplicate the original provider/basis/term/beneficiary business identity.

#### MC-06

Id: MC-06
Rule: Creator rates are exact signed/reviewed fractions, not a global30% default. Rates/denominators, centavo remainder and corrected total/delta projection must follow shared financial definitions; no implicit approximate decimal conversion.

#### MC-07

Id: MC-07
Rule: A review may record pending/rejected negative evidence without fabricated verified approval; readiness-specific positive proof remains mandatory.

#### MC-08

Id: MC-08
Rule: ReadingAttempt eligibility/cohort is established at qualifying actual start; login after guest access cannot retroactively identify guest history by convenience. Denied delivery never counts as a start.

#### MC-09

Id: MC-09
Rule: A valid positive transfer is bounded by approved unpaid obligation; confirmed payment/reversal history, correction/recovery/offset and authority usage remain separate. Arrival order never reopens a reversed event blindly.

#### MC-10

Id: MC-10
Rule: New review text/content binary creates a new revision and required fresh review; supplier/client cannot supply final grant/publication/paid/moderation authority.

#### MC-11

Id: MC-11
Rule: Rating scale/bounds and account/data-request policy must be actually reviewed; no invented default stars, consent, account merge or D35 retention authorization.

#### MC-12

Id: MC-12
Rule: Only the two existing Manga report purposes remain current report projections. Candidate/report links require exact definition/version/cohort/privacy purpose, no new Central export whitelist.

### Local nested types


#### payment_schedule

Exact registry lookup name: payment_schedule
Kind: list
Minimum items: 1

#### Item fields

Trigger id: qualified_local_id
Trigger kind: ADVANCE|ACCEPTED_MILESTONE|FINAL_ACCEPTANCE|SPECIFIED_CONTRACT_DATE
Trigger subject ref: versioned_record_reference
Due centavos: nonnegative_integer
Currency: PHP
Due rule ref: protected_evidence_reference
Constraints:
Unique trigger identity within exact contract revision; schedule totals and conditional maximum reconcile to full bounded obligation.; Advance is a cash/application term, not automatic expense; unknown amount or open-ended exposure holds commitment.

#### advance_applications

Exact registry lookup name: advance_applications
Kind: list
Minimum items: 0

#### Item fields

Application id: qualified_local_id
Original advance entry ref: versioned_record_reference
Target invoice ref: versioned_record_reference
Applied centavos: positive_integer
Independent finance review ref: versioned_record_reference
Constraints:
Cumulative application never exceeds actual unconsumed advance or eligible invoice balance.; One original application identity has one economic effect; original/correction lineage retained.

#### episode_schedule

Exact registry lookup name: episode_schedule
Kind: list
Minimum items: 1

#### Item fields

Episode id: qualified_local_id
Planned duration seconds: positive_integer
Language: code
Milestone ref: versioned_record_reference
Delivery due at: utc_instant
Constraints:
Exact immutable brief version; changed episodes/languages/duration need current scope/change review.

#### media_check_results

Exact registry lookup name: media_check_results
Kind: list
Minimum items: 1

#### Item fields

Manifest item id: qualified_local_id
Profile check code: code
Result: PASS|FAIL|NOT_APPLICABLE|UNAVAILABLE
Evidence ref: protected_evidence_reference
Verified by ref: versioned_record_reference
Constraints:
Every required profile check has an actual result for the same immutable asset; UNAVAILABLE cannot support QC PASS.

#### content_interval

Exact registry lookup name: content_interval
Kind: record

#### Field definitions

Start content millisecond: nonnegative_integer
End content millisecond: positive_integer
Constraints:
Start < end <= exact media duration; half-open interval.; Only actual eligible delivered coverage accepted; union across overlaps within same attempt; precision retained until final definition conversion.; 120contentseconds at2x may be60elapsedseconds; this shape makes no actual wall-time claim.

#### list_of_versioned_references

Exact registry lookup name: list_of_versioned_references
Kind: list
Minimum items: 0
Item type ref: pa06_logical_types.json#/types/VersionedReference
Constraints:
Required review scope decides whether the list must be nonempty; empty means no actual referenced event, never fabricated evidence.

#### list_of_field_errors

Exact registry lookup name: list_of_field_errors
Kind: list
Minimum items: 0
Item type ref: pa06_logical_types.json#/types/FieldErrorDescriptor
Constraints:
Only safe errors for the original request/row; no unrelated account or protected contents.

#### Same application retried

Case: Same application retried
Required outcome: Return the original receipt without a second verified supplier.

#### Conflicting representative evidence

Required outcome: Keep review pending/held and retain both claims.

#### Applicant requests another supplier case

Required outcome: Deny object access without exposing the other dossier.
Next actions:
Request exact missing mandate/signer evidence or record independently verified qualification.; A verified licensor may offer titles; title rights still need separate review.
Transaction boundary: One supplier-application revision and its actual qualification/review result are recorded once; verified role creation is separate from receiving it.

#### Provider refund and chargeback affect the same charge

Required outcome: Keep actual pending/failed cash distinct from approved credit; no blind second transfer.

#### Outage or refund is reported after a revenue period

Case: Outage or refund is reported after a revenue period
Required outcome: Record reviewed service-loss/financial correction without erasing genuine history or autoextending the paid period.
Next actions:
Record verified provider debits/reversals even while discretionary review remains pending; reconcile original history once.; Route actual authorized Finance/departmental decision and D34 fraud/dispute/exception escalation as applicable; undefined discretionary authority holds instruction for Owner review, not fact recording.
Transaction boundary: Each original claim/approved credit/provider cash adjustment has its own once-only binding; real provider facts are recorded independently of discretionary approval timing.

### Action guard rules


#### REQUEST_PREPAID_CHECKOUT

Policy status: PROPOSED_AN-PREPAID-P1
Must be true:
own_verified_account; offer_terms_presented; policy_adopted; no_active_paid_period; no_unresolved_checkout

#### Equal values

Agreed total centavos: 20000
Currency: PHP
Failure outcome: PURCHASE_NOT_ELIGIBLE or original PENDING_RECONCILIATION; no new charge attempt.

#### RECORD_PROVIDER_CHARGE_FACT

Must be true:
provider_identity_verified; provider_evidence_verified; provider_transaction_identity_verified
Not required:
discretionary_owner_approval; activation_ready; current_positive_content_rights; matched_local_checkout; known_local_obligation
Failure outcome: Unverified evidence remains held without claiming confirmed provider cash. Verified unmatched fact remains PENDING_RECONCILIATION in original unresolved local case, without guessed checkout or local obligation.

#### Conditional must be true

Apply to local checkout:
original_charge_binding_verified; matched_checkout_offer_account

#### ACTIVATE_PREPAID_PERIOD

Policy status: PROPOSED_AN-PREPAID-P1
Must be true:
policy_adopted; actual_charge_confirmed; original_charge_binding_verified; service_ready; no_active_paid_period; no_existing_period_for_charge; no_overlap

#### Equal values

Agreed total centavos: 20000
Currency: PHP
Duration seconds: 2592000
Temporal rule: paid_end_at=activated_at+2592000seconds; activated_at is actual issuance time, never backdated to provider occurrence.
Failure outcome: PAYMENT_CONFIRMED_ACTIVATION_PENDING or REMEDY_REVIEW; real cash remains recorded.

#### ISSUE_PRODUCTION_NTP

Must be true:
contract_executed_exact_version; brief_approved_exact_version; current_source_production_rights; current_stage_owner_authority; available_approved_budget; independent_finance_review; authority_conditions_satisfied
Failure outcome: DENIED or ON_HOLD; tender envelope alone creates no paid-work authority.
Stage note: Requested development, pilot or production stage must match independently allowed stage exactly; tender-only authority never supports paid-work NTP.

#### Equal fields

Requested stage: allowed_stage

#### RECORD_PROVIDER_ADJUSTMENT_FACT

Must be true:
provider_evidence_verified; original_charge_binding_verified; economic_adjustments_reconciled
Not required:
discretionary_owner_approval; current_positive_content_rights
Failure outcome: DISPUTED/PENDING_RECONCILIATION; record truthful received fact and reconcile, never invent discretionary authorization.

#### REVIEW_SUBSCRIBER_REMEDY

Must be true:
actual_original_charge_matched; independent_finance_review; current_actual_remedy_authority; economic_remedy_lineage_verified
Not required:
merch_php2000_threshold; current_positive_content_rights
Failure outcome: UNDER_REVIEW; undefined discretionary authority routes Owner clarification, not automatic rejection of actual money facts.

#### REQUEST_PLAYBACK

Must be true:
own_verified_account; current_paid_interval; account_access_permitted; current_episode_rights; verified_region_platform; exact_media_qc_pass; current_catalog_published; audience_device_policy_pass
Failure outcome: DENIED or TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE; no delivered watch start created.

#### SUBMIT_PLAYBACK_PROGRESS

Must be true:
own_attempt_and_authorization; same_immutable_media; actual_eligible_delivery; valid_content_bounds
Failure outcome: REJECTED/ON_HOLD; duplicate same sequence contributes once, seek-only position contributes no coverage.

#### MODERATE_FEEDBACK

Must be true:
independent_moderator; authorized_for_object; same_feedback_revision
Failure outcome: REJECTED; author cannot self-approve and edits cannot reuse old review.

#### RESTORE_CATALOG_SCOPE

Must be true:
restriction_independently_resolved; current_episode_rights; exact_media_qc_pass; current_catalog_eligibility
Failure outcome: BLOCKED; governance role cannot create a grant.

#### REVIEW_LICENSE_EXECUTION

Must be true:
actual_supplier_signature; actual_loxada_signature; same_approved_terms_version; signer_capacity_verified; current_exact_stage_authority; independent_rights_review; independent_finance_review
Failure outcome: PENDING_SIGNATURES/ON_HOLD; unsigned terms remain recordable without fake signature evidence.

#### REVIEW_PRIME_CONTRACT_EXECUTION

Must be true:
actual_supplier_signature; actual_loxada_signature; same_approved_terms_version; signer_capacity_verified; current_exact_stage_authority; current_required_source_scope; independent_finance_review

#### Conditional must be true

Is novation:
approved_novation_purpose; former_prime_closeout_reviewed; surviving_liabilities_reconciled
Failure outcome: PENDING_SIGNATURES/ON_HOLD; proposal/bid/advance not an executed contract.

#### MATCH_PROVIDER_CHARGE_TO_CHECKOUT

Must be true:
provider_identity_verified; provider_evidence_verified; provider_transaction_identity_verified; original_charge_binding_verified; matched_checkout_offer_account; amount_currency_match; later_adjustments_reconciled
Failure outcome: PENDING_RECONCILIATION; retain original verified money fact with null checkout and unresolved case, no guessed local allocation or access effect.

#### Canonical actual promised-service evidence; local ServiceAvailabilityLoss is review/claim linkage over this same inci…

Record family: ServiceAvailabilityEvent
Source: pa06_source_records.json
Purpose: Canonical actual promised-service evidence; local ServiceAvailabilityLoss is review/claim linkage over this same incident, not duplicate outage or automatic second consideration reduction.
Operation rules:
Local record completeness is not a universal submission form. Nullable future review/generated fields may be absent before their event. required_on_submit applies only to that named action; success-state requirements apply only after actual outcome.
Claimed input and protected evidence pointers never create authority; role/object/current delegation and independently verified exact subject/version checked outside client body.
Every update binds original subject and expected version. Same retry returns one original receipt; conflicting reuse holds. Original evidence, corrections and effective facts stay traceable.
Each source predecessor list uses the explicit predecessor_rule; not all listed IDs are universal AND gates. Acquired and commissioned content reuse shared QC/catalog/streaming without duplicate stores.
Owner/Central outcomes received locally are read-only independent evidence. Local routine qualified acquisition<=50000PHP does not need irrelevant Owner evidence; every new prime commission does.
A-B-04 tender authorization is limited nonbinding invitation authority. Production NTP requires exact current contract/brief/source rights/budget/independent reviews and stage authority.
Original/adapted rights, produced-work contribution chain, contractual production acceptance and current streaming grants are distinct. A payment/invoice/positive KPI cannot substitute.
Verified actual provider money facts recorded even when activation/discretionary remedy review pending. Provider occurrence, receipt, reconciliation and activation distinct; duplicates/out-of-order facts cannot silently restore access.
Selected PHP200/30-day offer has no trial/grace/autorenew/alternate plan. Exact start/re-purchase/noqueue/nooverlap recommendations need AN-PREPAID-P1 adoption; unresolved adoption holds discretionary issuance.
Expiry uses trusted current clock and half-open paid interval independently of callbacks. Outage does not autoextend, cancellation request does not auto-refund or delete genuine viewing history.
Actual promised-service loss reviewed separately from elapsed time, voluntary nonuse, or missing unpromised single title. Unknown service/credit basis holds affected earned/deferred claims, not actual money facts.
Subscriber remedy has independent authority, financial credit, original charge adjustment and access-effect evidence. Never copy Merchandise PHP2000 authority rule into Anime.
Gross invoice16800000centavos less single original advance4800000centavos yields final cash12000000centavos. With earlier4800000+7200000 cash, total24000000; never apply advance twice.
Progress interval coverage counts unique eligible content positions per attempt. Playback speed/rewind does not turn that coverage into real wall-time; replay new attempt and late completion original cohort.
No raw subscribers, contacts, viewing history, payment credentials or restricted supplier dossier leaves department. New proposed descriptors/retention do not authorize real personal-data processing.
Subscription plan finance remains plan/period-grained; title engagement is separate. Local report readiness, Admin reviewed outcome, Steward permission and Central accepted publication remain separate.
Closure/erasure cannot fabricate historical distinct accounts after activity destruction; permitted retained financial/reconciliation evidence may support bounded correction with explicit reconstruction limits.
A verified external provider event/transaction may have no known local checkout or obligation. Retain provider identity, original event/transaction, verified amount/currency/time and unresolved case with checkout_ref null. Only independently matched exact checkout/account/offer/amount/currency may produce local obligation allocation or entitlement; no lost cash fact and no guessed match.
Successor verification obligations:
Derive and verify technical designs/physical keys/protocols and implementations against this accepted baseline; retain independent actual source/case/batch evidence and authorization.
Instance-specific missing terms, rights, attribution, cost or provider facts still produce the specified HOLD/UNAVAILABLE; business acceptance does not fabricate them.

State and action rules:
Persisted record nullability is lifecycle-aware: pending or declined decisions do not require fictional future approved scope, signature, cash, receipt, stock or publication evidence.
Only fields listed on the exact permitted action may be submitted. Required-on-submission fields are not a claim that every other record field belongs on that form. Independent result fields cannot be set by customer/supplier body input.
Every edit requires verified original object relationship and expected immutable record revision. Same unchanged retry returns the original outcome; conflicting replay is held with safe correction feedback.
Negative, intake and disputed facts may be recorded without positive new-use rights or spending approval. Missing authority blocks discretionary execution, not lawful debt, remedy or provider fact recording.
All local field sets remain local and purpose protected. Public catalog results and supplier/customer feedback are minimized views, never full evidence records; no raw customer identity crosses to Central.
PA05 canonical purpose and authority stage must match the exact business action. Routine qualified wholesale <=5000000 centavos may use local delegation with independent rights/Finance/budget; exclusive manufacture and material/exclusive exceptions require Owner at every amount.
Keep exact source process result codes. Display terms LIVE, accepted, authorized and paid are not interchangeable technical state aliases.
Financial values are signed integer centavos with explicit PHP currency. Quantities are integer physical units, never money. Unknown final cost, unobserved cash and suppressed reports never use false zero.
Current provider, numerical checkout timeout, upload profile and technical identity parameters remain implementation choices needing reviewed configuration; canonical business fields/states and failure behavior are explicit here. No live provider is selected.
The 15-minute unpaid-stock-hold duration is a concrete recommended configuration in the shared PA06 proposal, not an adopted D34 rule. Actual expires_at must cite the reviewed configuration version; paid quantity never expires under that unpaid rule.

### Quantity and cost controls


#### OWNERSHIP_PARTITION

Id: OWNERSHIP_PARTITION
Rule: Physical custody partitions into owned accepted, owned quarantine, supplier-held rejects and shortage discrepancy. Supplier-held rejects never enter owned stock or its cost.

#### Witness

Ordered: 100
Physically received: 100
Owned accepted: 92
Owned quarantine: 0
Supplier held rejected: 8
Owned total: 92

#### PARTIAL_ALLOCATION

Id: PARTIAL_ALLOCATION
Rule: Allocate original unit claims into unpaid-held, paid-unfulfilled-eligible, paid-suspended, dispatched and discharged/cancelled buckets with immutable transitions. Dispatch cannot exceed eligible paid unconsumed quantity; pick/pack does not dispatch.

#### Witness

Paid units: 5
Paid warehouse units: 3
Paid in transit units: 2
Paid delivered units: 0
Paid cancelled settled units: 0
Paid owed unallocated units: 0

#### RECALL_PAID_DEMAND

Id: RECALL_PAID_DEMAND
Rule: On recall remove affected unit from sellable physical availability and suspend its eligible allocation; paid obligation remains owed until reviewed reallocation, fulfillment or authorized remedy discharges it. Never reject physical quarantine merely to preserve available-stock arithmetic.

#### Witness

Owned onhand: 1
Eligible allocated before: 1
Quarantined after: 1
Eligible allocated after: 0
Paid owed unallocated units: 1
Paid units: 1
Sellable available after: 0

#### LOT_CENTAVO_CONSERVATION

Id: LOT_CENTAVO_CONSERVATION
Rule: Authoritative reviewed lot total cost is integer centavos. Equal-unit allocation is allowed only if Finance approved that basis; deterministic immutable unit order assigns first remainder units one extra centavo. Unresolved freight/basis leaves final valuation unavailable while custody quantity remains known.

#### Witness

Lot total centavos: 101
Quantity: 3
Reviewed equal unit basis: Yes
Ordered unit costs centavos:
34; 34; 33
Sum centavos: 101

#### ACTUAL_CONTROL_TRANSFER

Id: ACTUAL_CONTROL_TRANSFER
Rule: Pick remains owned warehouse; verified dispatch transfers owned value to in-transit; actual supported delivered control-transfer portion recognizes sales/COGS using original issue-lot value exactly once. Lost transit, reimbursement and replacement remain separately reviewed.

#### EXPECTED_RETURN_SEPARATION

Id: EXPECTED_RETURN_SEPARATION
Rule: Finance-reviewed ExpectedReturnEstimate links original delivered sale/issue/SKU/period, supported basis and revision; estimate refund liability/recovery value is not cash. Later credit/physical recovery reverses or utilizes original estimate components once; no default rate is invented.

#### ECONOMIC_REMEDY_NON_DUPLICATION

Id: ECONOMIC_REMEDY_NON_DUPLICATION
Rule: Credit and cash settling that credit are one economic remedy. Original charge, pending refunds, actual chargebacks/reversals and separate additional remedies are reconciled. Preserve all actual external effects and escalate excess/unknown exposure rather than claiming banks cannot double-credit.

#### MANUFACTURING_ADVANCE_APPLICATION

Id: MANUFACTURING_ADVANCE_APPLICATION
Rule: Gross accepted-goods obligation minus previously paid advance applied once minus confirmed credits equals remaining due. Full cap, commitment, expense/inventory and cash remain separate.

#### Witness

Gross obligation centavos: 16800000
Prior advance applied centavos: 4800000
Credits centavos: 0
Net due centavos: 12000000
Successor verification obligations:
Derive and verify technical designs/physical keys/protocols and implementations against this accepted baseline; retain independent actual source/case/batch evidence and authorization.
Instance-specific missing terms, rights, attribution, cost or provider facts still produce the specified HOLD/UNAVAILABLE; business acceptance does not fabricate them.

#### Owned custody partition

Equals field: physically_received_quantity

supplier_held_rejected_quantity; shortage_quantity

prior_advance_applied_centavos; credits_centavos

All nonnegative: Yes

Scope: MERCH_CUSTOMER_REMEDY_ONLY

fraud; dispute; exceptional_loss
Independent finance always: Yes
Claim intake allowed at any amount: Yes
Credit and its cash settlement share economic identity: Yes

#### CG-01

Process id: CG-01
Source summary: Set versioned department authority
Accountable source actor: SUPER_ADMIN
Source primary store: ApprovalAuthorityPolicy
Input field sets:
AuthorityPolicyRevision
Stored evidence reads:
Resolve actual Owner identity and the exact prior policy/allocation revision; a requester or body role label is not authority.
Apply D34 department/action/PHP/risk scope, twelve-calendar-month maximum delegation, independent review and PHP 50,000 routine boundary; a new exclusive/commission case remains Owner-required at every amount.
Reconcile approved allocation against settled exposure plus remaining binding exposure counted once; new approval cannot retroactively validate unauthorized spending.
Logical record writes:
AuthorityPolicyRevision

Action references:
DECIDE_AUTHORITY_POLICY

Shared contract references — entry 2
Artifact: pa06_coordination_records.json
Field set: delegation_receipt

MANGA_BUDGET_CHANGE; MANGA_DELEGATION_UPDATE; ANIME_BUDGET_CHANGE; ANIME_DELEGATION_UPDATE; MERCH_BUDGET_CHANGE; MERCH_DELEGATION_UPDATE
Allowed result states:
RECORDED_ACTIVE; SCHEDULED; REVOKED; INVALID; HELD_CONFLICT
Conditional predecessor rule: No predecessor policy is required for an initial proposal. Resolve an existing policy only for amendment/revocation. Actual Owner authority is required for activation, not for recording an invalid or denied attempt.
Exceptions:
Wrong department/action/currency, missing independent review or expired effective period: reject activation and return correction requirements.
Same policy revision with changed content or conflicting concurrent update: retain prior version and hold for Owner reconciliation.
Revocation/expiry stops new unauthorized actions; preserve lawful commitments and liabilities and appoint a current authorized operator rather than erasing debt.
Next actions:
Notify affected Admin/Finance roles of the exact effective revision and record each actual acknowledgment separately.; Affected commitment/payment operators recheck current authority; route uncovered exceptions to CG-18 and material existing-case changes to CG-11.
Transaction boundary: One versioned policy/allocation decision is recorded against its original proposal. Authority activation, departmental receipt and later financial execution are separate business effects.
Common result fields reference: common_result_fields
Status: PROPOSED_LOGICAL_DICTIONARY

department; action_scope; safe_deficiency_codes

Reconcile approved allocation against settled exposure plus remaining binding exposure counted once; new approval cannot retroactively validate unauthorized spending.
Persist decision only for independently authenticated actual Owner and independently read findings; requester-supplied proof or role fields are not accepted as verification.

### Common result fields

| Field / logical type | Record requiredness | Meaning | Controls / references |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| original_request_reference<br>VersionedReference | Nullable: No | Exact original source request/record version receiving this outcome. | Classification: CONFIDENTIAL_PURPOSE_SCOPED_CENTRAL; Raw customer data allowed: No |
| handling_state<br>code | Nullable: No | Actual handled/held/denied/correction result, not invented success. | Classification: CONFIDENTIAL_PURPOSE_SCOPED_CENTRAL; Raw customer data allowed: No |
| safe_errors<br>FieldErrorDescriptor[] | Nullable: No | Minimized corrective fields/codes. | Classification: CONFIDENTIAL_PURPOSE_SCOPED_CENTRAL; Raw customer data allowed: No |
| actual_effect_reference<br>VersionedReference | Nullable: Yes | Committed intake/decision/publication only when it actually occurred. | Classification: CONFIDENTIAL_PURPOSE_SCOPED_CENTRAL; Raw customer data allowed: No |
| next_action<br>short_text | Nullable: No | Named receiver and required correction or review; no automatic operational authority. | Classification: CONFIDENTIAL_PURPOSE_SCOPED_CENTRAL; Raw customer data allowed: No |

Operation rules:
Record fields describe durable logical state; action-specific editable fields and conditional requirements prevent a single universal mandatory form.
Failed lookup/review/validation remains recordable without successful approval or published output.
Actual Owner decision, department receipt, independent rights/Finance review and local execution are distinct events. No four-distinct-human blanket requirement is introduced; applicable prohibited requester/approver conflicts remain enforced.
Central never writes a department operational record, grants legal rights from a mapping, executes cash or issues a supplier NTP.
Seven Central dataset purposes remain candidate-only and release_authorized false; manufacturing-project report stays local-only.
Privacy whole-row withholding, zero/unavailable distinction and separate freshness use shared typed descriptors. Central receives no raw reader/viewer/buyer IDs or provider payloads.
D35 adopts record-purpose classroom retention durations, not law-prescribed deadlines; access audit and financial decision lineage cannot share a blanket expiry.
Logical source-store/action coverage is distinct from exact external field parity, provider wire formats, database constraints, balanced DFDs and implemented runtime.
Successor verification obligations:
Derive and verify technical designs/physical keys/protocols and implementations against this accepted baseline; retain independent actual source/case/batch evidence and authorization.
Instance-specific missing terms, rights, attribution, cost or provider facts still produce the specified HOLD/UNAVAILABLE; business acceptance does not fabricate them.

### Validation rules


#### CEN-V01

Id: CEN-V01
Meaning: Action editable and independent/generated fields must be disjoint and refer to its exact record shape.

#### CEN-V02

Id: CEN-V02
Meaning: Any resulting state must be both an action result and the source-process result.

#### CEN-V03

Id: CEN-V03
Meaning: All nonnullable record fields and state-conditional required fields must be real; state-forbidden success effects are absent.

#### CEN-V04

Id: CEN-V04
Meaning: Independent Owner outcome actions reject same requester/approver identity, without inventing blanket all-role distinctness.

#### CEN-V05

Id: CEN-V05
Meaning: Executable approval requires exact supported purpose/stage/scope/cap/time and independent rights/Finance findings; a conditional outcome has no execution effect by itself.

#### CEN-V06

Id: CEN-V06
Meaning: Central datasets are the seven candidate purposes; no manufacturing-project dataset or raw customer identifiers are accepted.

#### CEN-V07

Id: CEN-V07
Meaning: A resolved incident cannot have any remaining unresolved material corrective condition, cash uncertainty or claim.

#### CEN-V08

Id: CEN-V08
Meaning: General governance intake is distinct from a purpose-bound authority exception and cannot invent a decision during intake.

### Reference-validation boundary

Is runtime implementation: No
Meaning: Test-only independently supplied facts exercise declared requirements, not a trusting API body.

#### Field definitions

Actor role: Actual independently resolved role; not persisted input role.
Requester identity: Original bounded requester identity.
Decision actor identity: Actual authenticated decision actor for restricted Owner decision.
Unresolved material conditions: Independently verified incident/reconciliation list; empty required for RESOLVED.
Purpose stage supported: Exact shared PA05 profile/stage independently matched.
Authority complete: Exact executable scope/cap/time/terms and current checks actually present.
Prohibited input fields: Raw department customer/provider data is forbidden regardless of actor.
Execution requested: Test attempt to treat this decision as immediate local execution; conditional decisions remain blocked.
Existing finance authority verified: Independent current authority proof for the canonical Anime subscriber remedy only; never requester assertion.

Correlation rules:
Original sender system, department case identity and business purpose remain bound through intake, Owner outcome and receipts.
Central committed case identity is learned only from confirmed intake, never guessed from a rejected or timed-out request.
Owner outcome is tied to original case, decision identity/version and approved terms; local receivers keep read-only history and cannot change Owner authority.
Exact repeat has no second business effect; conflicting replay, wrong case/purpose, stale revision or changed approved terms is held/rejected for independent review.
Transport delivery, human portal viewing, recorded business receipt, Owner approval and financial execution remain distinct evidence.
Not selected:
Protocol/authentication provider/credentials; Exact typed fields, persistence schema and DFD route registration; Canonical mapping/privacy/metric/retention policy of full D30 baseline; Automatic merge of held PRs or real commercial integration

### Common stage contracts


#### Request

Meaning: Accountable origin preserves and submits exact business case; no independent authority from sender assertion.
Minimum business content:
origin system/department and local case identity
named business purpose and source path
immutable submission revision and retained original content
exact subject and original contract/decision/terms
requested stage/scope/period and bounded full related PHP exposure where applicable
independent grouping, budget, rights and Finance assessment or explicit missing-evidence reasons
necessary protected evidence references; no raw customer history or payment secrets
Responses:
recorded intake identity; actionable needs-correction; rejected with safe reason; pending/unknown delivery

#### Intake

Meaning: Confirmed Central handling binds original department/case/purpose/submission; not Owner approval.
Minimum business content:
exact original submission binding; actual Central case only if recorded; recorded/correction/rejection result and time; safe reason and corrective evidence needed
Responses:
case recorded awaiting decision; case needs correction; case rejected; no executable authority

#### Independent outcome

Meaning: Actual independent Owner record; department may not edit it or substitute a receipt.
Minimum business content:
same original case/purpose/submission and retained terms
actual independent Owner authority and decision identity/revision
approved/conditional/declined/deferred/revoked or clarification-only status
precise scope/stage/cap/period and independent execution conditions for authorizing outcomes
explicit no-authority state for declined/deferred/revoked/clarification-only
prior decision supersession and surviving obligations when applicable
Responses:
separate immutable Owner outcome to department; decision remains pending if no actual independent record

#### Local receipt

Meaning: Department stores exact received outcome read-only and confirms only its actual local recording.
Minimum business content:
exact original case/purpose/submission and Owner decision/revision; actual local receipt identity and time; recorded/wrong-case/conflict/stale/needs-clarification status; safe meaningful reason; no fabricated receipt for a portal view
Responses:
receipt recorded; held wrong case or purpose; held conflict or stale outcome; pending/unknown until actually received

### Semantics


#### S01

Id: S01
Rule: Only exact same case/purpose/submission revision/content repeats one business effect. Changed content at same revision conflicts; legitimate changed terms require a new retained submission revision.

#### S02

Id: S02
Rule: An Owner decision binds persisted original department/source case/purpose/subject/submission and exact approved terms. Wrong department/case/path/stage cannot be rebound by an incoming body.

#### S03

Id: S03
Rule: Requester identity cannot supply the independently required Owner, rights or Finance decision. Role labels/body booleans are not proof of identity or current authority.

#### S04

Id: S04
Rule: Separate request, intake, independent outcome and local receipt; transport delivery, human portal read and operational execution are additional distinct facts.

#### S05

Id: S05
Rule: Unknown or unbounded exposure/grouping stays HOLD; clarification-only outcome is non-executable. A legitimate finite/capped reviewed case needs the matching spending purpose; no active formula exception invented.

#### S06

Id: S06
Rule: Conditional approval remains non-executable until every required independent condition is met. Declined/deferred/revoked/withdrawn requests authorize no new commitments.

#### S07

Id: S07
Rule: Approval is limited to the exact authorized stage. SAMPLE/development or PILOT permission requires its own current rights, signed scoped contract, cap and local NTP; no approved final sample is demanded before sample development itself. BULK manufacture additionally requires the accepted exact applicable sample and category/compliance gates. PRODUCTION requires the approved production brief, exercised adaptation or original-work rights and signed prime/NTP gates; final accepted masters and streaming grant are RELEASE/playback gates, not prerequisites to begin the work that creates them. Owner authority alone never supplies those independent gates.

#### S08

Id: S08
Rule: Verified supersession controls decision ordering, not largest revision number alone. Stale/conflicting returns remain in history and cannot overwrite current authority.

#### S09

Id: S09
Rule: Withdrawal before decision closes only the uncommitted request; an in-flight later outcome is held against withdrawal. Withdrawal after a commitment requires cancellation/settlement review and cannot erase liabilities.

#### S10

Id: S10
Rule: Expiry/revocation stops new or increased commitments under that authority. Existing valid liabilities survive, but current payment-operator authority and independent verification are required to settle them; no second budget reservation.

#### S11

Id: S11
Rule: Lost replies/provider timeouts remain pending/unknown against original identity. Reconcile original instruction; do not blindly create another case, payout, refund or commitment.

#### S12

Id: S12
Rule: Release only verified approved unperformed exposure after outstanding earned obligations, advances, charges, credits and remedies are reconciled. Supplier-owned rejected goods are not owned stock.

#### S13

Id: S13
Rule: Full related exposure includes applicable stated fees/taxes/amendments and linked documents. Same supplier alone does not force all unrelated purchases into one commitment; unresolved grouping is held.

#### S14

Id: S14
Rule: Financial Owner approval does not clear legal/rights/privacy/safety vetoes, accept stock, prove supplier execution, create cash confirmation or earn customer revenue.

#### S15

Id: S15
Rule: Customer-remedy escalation carries only minimized local references/reason/amount/remaining-balance and required reviewed evidence. No customer identity/address/payment credentials/history is sent to Central. Internal review does not reset filing time or extinguish remedies.

#### S16

Id: S16
Rule: One accountable prime/manufacturer per effective project/stage interval; novation preserves old duties and changes future responsibility only under reviewed signed terms and fresh affected readiness checks.

#### S17

Id: S17
Rule: These are business responsibilities within existing process families, not new registered endpoints, final wire payloads, database schemas, balanced DFDs or implemented workflow.

#### S18

Id: S18
Rule: A later whole-project cap includes previously authorized/committed/settled exposure for the same obligation; it is not added as a second complete budget. A PHP5,000 sample stage followed by PHP25,000 approved total project cap means PHP25,000 overall cap and PHP20,000 increase, not PHP30,000. Settled plus outstanding used exposure counts once; payments never restore authority. Distinct additional obligations require their own documented grouping, not assumed duplication or cancellation.

#### S19

Id: S19
Rule: Customer remedy value follows distinct underlying obligations/effects. A PHP2,000 approved credit settled by the same PHP2,000 cash refund remains one PHP2,000 remedy, not PHP4,000. Separate additional remedies and prior remaining refundable balance must be reconciled; do not double-count credit, cash application or replacement valuation as duplicate authority exposure, and do not split one larger remedy into artificial routine cases.

#### S20

Id: S20
Rule: Independent review means the requester cannot perform the independently required Owner/rights/Finance decision on the same restricted case. A person may hold several qualified roles where that separation is preserved; no blanket requirement for four distinct humans is invented. Routine local decisions do not require an irrelevant Owner approval record.

#### S21

Id: S21
Rule: Initial Owner whole-project cap/tender approval is valid as TENDER_ENVELOPE before bids/executed contract, but authorizes no supplier commitment or paid execution. Exact later contract/stage approval remains distinct and must include the prior same-obligation cap/use; historical PROJECT_COMMITMENT requires explicit scope mapping and otherwise stays HOLD.

#### S22

Id: S22
Rule: Positive current-use rights are required for new protected use, not to record/refund a lawful existing financial claim, inspect/reconcile safety loss, cancel future work or settle a valid liability. Separate legal review of remedy/settlement remains necessary. Actual verified provider refund/chargeback facts are recorded and reconciled regardless of pending discretionary approval; missing media remedy terms/authority remain HOLD and the Merchandise PHP2,000 rule is never imported.

### Local non owner controls

Local non owner controls — entry 1
Family: independent_review
Rule: Independent rights/Finance reviews stay local except necessary minimized exception evidence; missing/veto stays HOLD regardless of Owner money approval.
Local non owner controls — entry 2
Family: routine_remedy
Rule: Only Merchandise eligible ordinary whole-case remedies <= PHP2,000 with independent Finance can remain local; repeated/exceptional/above-limit handling uses its own case.
Local non owner controls — entry 3
Family: payment_verification
Rule: Local Finance executes only valid approved obligations using current operator authority and confirmed outcome; no new investment permission from a payout.
Local non owner controls — entry 4
Family: feasibility
Rule: Retain original PA05 request/intake/decision/investigation/receipt contract; no financial authority.
Local non owner controls — entry 5
Family: export_governance
Rule: Retain separate CG13/14/16 and departmental report controls; D35/privacy and exact fields remain PA06 work.

### Exit criteria


#### E01

Id: E01
Requirement: Every D34 trigger has a nonempty independent disposition for each affected department, with local/Owner/HOLD distinction.

#### E02

Id: E02
Requirement: Every required financial/exception purpose has source family, purpose-preserving Central family, source extension, four distinct business stages and named local return.

#### E03

Id: E03
Requirement: Manga monetary/exclusive/change/renewal/cancellation, Anime renewal/license/prime changes/novation/termination, wholesale/manufacturing changes/settlements, all department budget/delegation and Merch remedy/loss exceptions have explicit purpose coverage.

#### E04

Id: E04
Requirement: Independent identity, wrong-purpose/case/stage, replay/conflict/stale/supersession, withdrawal, conditions, expiry, unbounded exposure and surviving liability paper cases are reviewed.

#### E05

Id: E05
Requirement: All original seven XS/seventeen XG entries and all151 source IDs remain; no new registered routes or final fields are inferred.

#### E06

Id: E06
Requirement: Planning tests reject missing escalation mapping, foreign department process, self-approval, sample-to-bulk misuse and unbounded-as-zero authority. Passing only verifies scoped specification checks.
Successor verification obligations:
Actual PA06 field/type/nested-descriptor and source-store read/write equality for these purpose extensions
Final route registration, authenticated transport, transactional persistence and independent runtime verification
Unbounded variable share remains unsupported for binding under D34 until supported terms or separately reviewed policy exists; no new formula authority adopted
D35 information/privacy package acceptance, all nine existing freeze blockers and whole PA07 review remain separate
Evidence note: PA-05-AUTHORITY-HANDOFFS
Stage vocabulary boundary: Canonical business stages below separate early project-cap/tender authority from exact contract or operational stage authority. They are not finalized wire enums. Historical PA06 PROJECT_COMMITMENT is not canonical execution authority and must be mapped explicitly by source purpose, approved terms, stage scope and conditions; ambiguous historical values remain HOLD. No default alias can authorize BULK, PRODUCTION or RELEASE.

### Budget boundary cases


#### CAP01

Id: CAP01
Description: Sample stage is included in a later whole-project cap.
Prior authorized cap centavos: 500000
New whole project cap centavos: 2500000
Approved cap delta centavos: 2000000
Same obligation settled centavos: 200000
Same obligation outstanding centavos: 300000
Used exposure centavos: 500000
Available authority centavos: 2000000

#### CAP02

Id: CAP02
Description: A payment moves part of an original commitment to settled history without budget restoration.
Prior authorized cap centavos: 10000000
New whole project cap centavos: 10000000
Approved cap delta centavos: 0
Same obligation settled centavos: 1500000
Same obligation outstanding centavos: 2500000
Used exposure centavos: 4000000
Available authority centavos: 6000000

### Canonical stage meanings


#### CONTRACT_COMMITMENT

Meaning: Exact reviewed binding supplier/agreement scope and full related exposure within current explicit Owner authority; signed parties/rights and independent conditions still independently checked.
Does not authorize: Local notice to proceed or another project/stage by status alone.

#### EXCLUSIVE_GRANT

Meaning: exclusive grant
Does not authorize: Any other purpose/stage, independent rights clearance, supplier execution, local NTP, cash confirmation or earned revenue by label alone.

#### CHANGE

Meaning: change
Does not authorize: Any other purpose/stage, independent rights clearance, supplier execution, local NTP, cash confirmation or earned revenue by label alone.

#### RENEWAL_COMMITMENT

Meaning: renewal commitment
Does not authorize: Any other purpose/stage, independent rights clearance, supplier execution, local NTP, cash confirmation or earned revenue by label alone.

#### CANCELLATION_SETTLEMENT

Meaning: cancellation settlement
Does not authorize: Any other purpose/stage, independent rights clearance, supplier execution, local NTP, cash confirmation or earned revenue by label alone.

#### LICENSE_COMMITMENT

Meaning: license commitment
Does not authorize: Any other purpose/stage, independent rights clearance, supplier execution, local NTP, cash confirmation or earned revenue by label alone.

#### TENDER_ENVELOPE

Meaning: Owner approves an explicit whole-project planning cap and bounded precontract tender/feasibility scope, potentially before supplier bids, complete executed contract or final production rights. Conditions and unresolved findings remain visible.
Permits: Only stated nonbinding invitations/evaluation and necessary lawfully cleared evidence use; no paid supplier work or binding supplier obligation from this envelope alone.
Does not authorize: Contract execution, notice to proceed, sample/pilot/development/production/bulk work, accepted stock or streaming release.
Source alias: APPROVED_FOR_TENDER in A-B-04/R-B-04 only where retained actual decision scope confirms tender authority.

#### DEVELOPMENT

Meaning: Only stated limited prime-development work, not full production; its own contract/rights/cap/NTP scope must be current.
Does not authorize: PILOT, PRODUCTION, RELEASE or a fresh supplier obligation outside its terms.

#### PILOT

Meaning: Only stated pilot work under its own current contract/rights/cap/NTP scope.
Does not authorize: Full PRODUCTION or RELEASE by inference.

#### PRODUCTION

Meaning: Only stated prime-production scope after approved brief, appropriate exercised adaptation/original rights, signed prime/cap and local notice-to-proceed gates.
Does not authorize: Streaming release; final accepted masters/media and effective streaming grants are later RELEASE/playback prerequisites.

#### NOVATION

Meaning: novation
Does not authorize: Any other purpose/stage, independent rights clearance, supplier execution, local NTP, cash confirmation or earned revenue by label alone.

#### PO_COMMITMENT

Meaning: po commitment
Does not authorize: Any other purpose/stage, independent rights clearance, supplier execution, local NTP, cash confirmation or earned revenue by label alone.

#### SAMPLE

Meaning: Only the specified manufacturer sample/prototype-development scope with current rights, scoped signed contract/cap and local notice to proceed.
Does not authorize: BULK work, retail stock or use of a later changed sample as approved. An accepted final sample is not required to begin the work that creates that sample.

#### BULK

Meaning: Only stated bulk manufacture after exact applicable sample, rights/compliance, contract, cap and local notice-to-proceed gates.
Does not authorize: Accepted-stock posting, sale eligibility or broader category/quantity automatically.

#### CUSTOMER_REMEDY

Meaning: customer remedy
Does not authorize: Any other purpose/stage, independent rights clearance, supplier execution, local NTP, cash confirmation or earned revenue by label alone.

#### STOCK_LOSS

Meaning: stock loss
Does not authorize: Any other purpose/stage, independent rights clearance, supplier execution, local NTP, cash confirmation or earned revenue by label alone.

#### BUDGET_CHANGE

Meaning: budget change
Does not authorize: Any other purpose/stage, independent rights clearance, supplier execution, local NTP, cash confirmation or earned revenue by label alone.

#### CLARIFICATION_ONLY

Meaning: clarification only
Does not authorize: Any other purpose/stage, independent rights clearance, supplier execution, local NTP, cash confirmation or earned revenue by label alone.

#### DELEGATION_POLICY

Meaning: delegation policy
Does not authorize: Any other purpose/stage, independent rights clearance, supplier execution, local NTP, cash confirmation or earned revenue by label alone.

#### MEDIA_REMEDY_REVIEW

Meaning: Review/clarify exact existing media service remedy terms and current financial authority; unresolved terms remain non-executable.
Does not authorize: A new refund limit, imported Merchandise delegation, invented eligibility or reversal of already verified provider facts.

A tender cap maps to TENDER_ENVELOPE only; exact acquired license to LICENSE_COMMITMENT; exact wholesale PO to PO_COMMITMENT; other contract or specific operational authority needs explicit matching scope. If no precise retained scope exists, HOLD; never infer all stages.
Historical stage compatibility — entry 2
Historical: APPROVED_FOR_TENDER
Source: A-B-04/R-B-04 source lifecycle label
Handling: CONTEXTUAL_TENDER_ONLY
Rule: May identify TENDER_ENVELOPE only with the actual approved whole-project cap, bounded tender scope and recorded Owner evidence. It is not a production/contract/NTP alias.

Validation rules:
The32 profiles exactly refine the32 department-origin authority purposes in pa05_authority_handoffs.json; this does not prove wire-field or DFD route parity.
Three CENTRAL-origin delegation notices belong to coordination records. They do not require a fabricated departmental source_case_id or requester.
Routine valid local transactions follow existing D34 controls without inventing a Central case or Owner decision; these profiles apply only when the canonical trigger actually requires escalation.
Apply lifecycle_contract conditional requirements and profile-specific record sets. Missing evidence permits intake/correction/refusal records; authorizing outcomes require actual independent supported evidence.
Requested and approved scope/stage/cap are distinct. Approved terms can be narrower or differ legitimately, but only explicit independent approved scope governs the resulting case.
Refund/credit/cash application/replacement economic values are linked and counted once. Provider-confirmed cash facts are recorded independently from a pending discretionary remedy decision.
No raw customer history/contact/payment credentials or unrestricted contracts centrally. Typed protected references are purpose-scoped pointers, not download authorization.
Rights, authority, signed contract, supplier acceptance, NTP, QC, warehouse acceptance, payment and earned revenue remain independently evidenced.
No new threshold, provider timeout, transport/authentication/API implementation or real-world release authorization is selected here.
