### Lifecycle contract

Notation: Logical status/conditional-requiredness rules; no final wire/API/database schema or runtime validator claim.

#### Stage field sets

REQUEST:
case_binding; request
INTAKE:
case_binding; intake_result
OUTCOME:
case_binding; owner_outcome
LOCAL_RECEIPT:
case_binding; local_outcome_receipt

#### Rules


#### CASE01

Id: CASE01
Stage: REQUEST
Requires null:
central_case_id
Rule: A new case submission cannot assert a committed Central case before actual intake.

#### When

Submission context:
NEW_CASE

#### CASE02

Id: CASE02
Stage: INTAKE

#### When

Intake status:
RECORDED
Requires present:
central_case_id
Rule: Only actual RECORDED intake commits the case.

#### CASE03

Id: CASE03
Stage: OUTCOME
Requires present:
central_case_id; decision_id; decision_revision; authority_reference; decided_at
Rule: Outcome belongs to actual recorded case and independent decision.

#### CASE04

Id: CASE04
Stage: LOCAL_RECEIPT
Requires present:
central_case_id; decision_reference; local_receipt_id; recorded_at
Rule: Actual local handling references original decision and case; portal display/timeout is not a receipt.

#### AUTH01

Id: AUTH01
Stage: OUTCOME

#### When

Authority effect:
NONE
Requires null:
approved_stage; approved_cap_centavos; approved_scope_reference; effective_at; valid_until
Rule: No fictitious approved scope/cap/window on no-authority outcomes.

#### AUTH02

Id: AUTH02
Stage: OUTCOME

#### When

Authority effect:
LIMITED_SCOPE
Requires present:
approved_stage; approved_cap_centavos; approved_scope_reference; effective_at; valid_until; independent_finance_reference

#### Allowed values

Decision status:
APPROVED; CONDITIONAL
Rule: Only exact independently reviewed bounded scope can be granted; conditional still blocks execution until gates cleared.

#### AUTH03

Id: AUTH03
Stage: OUTCOME

#### When

Decision status:
DECLINED; DEFERRED; RETURNED; REVOKED; CLARIFICATION_ONLY

#### Allowed values

Authority effect:
NONE
Rule: Refusal/clarification grants no new action authority; existing lawful obligations are retained separately.

Rule: An approved bounded outcome states explicit scope. An unresolved inquiry uses CLARIFICATION_ONLY or refusal/returned state, never a misleading approved label.

#### ROLE01

Id: ROLE01
Stage: OUTCOME

#### When

Decision actor role:
FINANCE_REVIEWER

#### Allowed values

Owner requirement state:
VERIFIED_EXISTING_AUTHORITY
Rule: Canonical media inquiry only, with independently verified actual existing Finance authority; cannot satisfy Owner-required/unknown authority or introduce media policy.
Cross record constraints:
Original department/source case/purpose/submission revision/content/subjects must match persisted records at each stage; received body cannot rebind them.
Owner and required independent reviewer identities resolve separately from caller fields; same identity under two role labels does not satisfy independence.
An authorizing outcome must use one exact canonical purpose stage and independently verified supported bounded exposure; UNKNOWN cannot become BOUNDED by Owner assertion.
CLARIFICATION_ONLY purpose/stage always has authority_effect NONE. Media inquiry cannot create new policy/delegation/eligibility or borrow the Merch PHP2,000 limit.
decision_actor_role FINANCE_REVIEWER is only possible in the canonical media-remedy inquiry where existing terms/current authority are independently verified; if Owner is required or unknown no new financial execution follows.
An already lawful payable/provider-confirmed cash fact survives original decision expiry; current operator and independent payment checks still required.
Exact retry one effect; changed same revision, wrong case/purpose/stage, stale outcome or unverified supersession HOLD. No largest-number-only authority.
A tender envelope authorizes nonbinding tender scope only, not paid work, contract signature, sample/development/pilot/production/bulk or release.

Comparison rules — entry 1
Stage: OUTCOME

#### When

Authority effect:
LIMITED_SCOPE
Left: effective_at
Relation: STRICTLY_BEFORE
Right: valid_until
Rule: Inclusive start must precede exclusive end.

#### Record variants


#### BOUND_PERMISSION

Logical field sets:
correlation; report_binding; export_permission
Condition: Source dataset/batch context actually resolved. APPROVED requires successful reviewed scope/window; DENIED is recordable without positive grant/privacy proof.

#### UNRESOLVED_INPUT

Logical field sets:
handling_provenance; permission_intake_attempt
Condition: Actual malformed/untrusted/missing-ID permission input or refusal; no required valid dataset, digest, mapping, period or approved columns. No business authority; reply only to verified authorized origin.
Field set semantics: Exactly one selected record_variants definition; common field_sets empty deliberately prevents successful report_binding from being imposed on negative unresolved input.

#### Receiver intake record variants


#### RESOLVED_BATCH

Logical field sets:
correlation; report_binding; export_manifest
Condition: Actual parsed claimed batch, only then subject to validation; no acceptance from shape alone.

#### UNRESOLVED_INPUT

Logical field sets:
handling_provenance; negative_report_intake
Condition: Actual receiver rejection attempt before a valid manifest can be formed; do not require forged dataset/partition/digest/period/mapping. authority_effect NONE; no publication/permission granted.
Field set semantics: Normal field_sets define a well-formed outgoing aggregate batch only. They are not prerequisites to recording its malformed/corrupt/untrusted receiver input through the explicit negative intake variant.

Local receipt: CG-01 sends immutable policy/version to the affected department; departmental responsible Admin records actual receipt/hold without granting wider scope or backdating an unauthorized commitment.

Constraints:
Logical field reuse does not authorize generic cross-purpose routing or a DFD umbrella. Existing 151 process IDs and boundary inventories unchanged; no missing route is claimed implemented.
Correlation in a reply repeats the original origin/system/record/purpose/revision/content binding; receiver identity belongs to independently verified reply provenance. A reply does not create a second original submission.
Referral target and original subjects/decision bind to retained Central case. Investigation only: no copyright grant, budget, contract or notice-to-proceed. One recorded receiver case per exact referral; repeat retains same case.
Business outcomes preserve original investment case/path/authority and obligations. Financial references retain measure grain/period/currency; no combined commitment+expense+cash total, subscription-to-title revenue or whole-SKU source/IP duplication.
All aggregate evidence cited by cases requires its own scoped disclosure review. Case reference is not permission to fetch restricted underlying data or bypass suppressed cohorts.
Only seven existing report purposes are Central candidates. Manufacturing-project report remains local-only. Every candidate remains release_authorized false until actual scoped package/purpose approval.
Permission binds department/dataset/definition/partition/batch revision/exact content/purpose/allowlist. Changed content or corrected batch needs its own reviewed permission; prior approval cannot authorize a new payload.
No APPROVED permission absent actual authority, privacy and confidentiality review. Accepted D35 thresholds/durations alone do not authorize sharing. DENIED/REVOKED cannot transmit a report batch.
Unknown keys, forbidden raw fields, wrong dataset owner, invalid period, wrong units, unverified digest or unresolved old-schema compatibility fail validation rather than silently drop/coerce data.
Permission valid at send/receipt does not guarantee permission at publication. Revocation/expiry before publication holds it. Previously published data require a separate recorded access/removal review, not invented deletion.
Manifest record counts, quality results, reconciliation references and errors must not reveal suppressed values. Privacy controls cover metadata and complementary/overlapping outputs too.
ACCEPTED validation does not mean PUBLISHED. Publication reference exists only on actual successful commit. Receipts and human portal reads never imply local software persistence.
Exact duplicate immutable batch/result is one effect. Same batch/revision with different content conflicts; unresolved stale/out-of-order correction is held. Corrected complete partition replaces prior accepted partition atomically in future implementation, never adds old and new totals.
Empty replacement partition can remove old rows only with explicit bound permission and validated completeness; no-data/withheld/zero are distinct, so empty transfer is not automatically a zero report.
Report results and their local receipts bind exact originating batch/partition/revision; do not permit a generic successful load notice to approve another dataset or correction.
Mapping notices require non-overlapping reviewed intervals or an explicit unresolved conflict. Local receipt means notice recorded, not that remapping/financial allocation/report republication occurred. D35 selects descriptive multi-IP tags without financial weights initially; whole-source values are never duplicated per tag.
Missing replies stay pending/unknown. Retry deadline/provider/serialization/signature/transport, physical persistence and runtime transactions remain future work.
The three canonical CENTRAL-origin delegation profiles use delegation_notice/receipt, not department request/case_binding. They are not counted among the32 department-origin four-stage authority cases.
Business investment outcomes cover only actual Central-reviewed investments; routine qualified local commitments require no fabricated Owner/case record.
Result status requiredness follows export_result_lifecycle. Negative/untrusted input is recordable with actual check-attempt evidence and nullable success refs.
Nested descriptor_ref definitions resolve to pa06_logical_types.json; pointers require purpose/object authorization and do not fetch raw content automatically.
Record-variant schemas are alternatives, not cumulative required fieldsets. Failed/untrusted input may be logged before a normal permission/case/report manifest exists, with actual received-content/check references and optional resolved identifiers. Unknown binding never grants a case, permission, authority or publication effect.

### Delegation lifecycle

Source: pa05_authority_handoffs.json CENTRAL-origin3profiles; exact Owner-issued policy evidence required.
Origin system: CENTRAL
Department request required: No
Department case required: No
Rules:
Notice target and exact policy/purpose/revision/scope are retained and independently verified; actual original policy may be Owner-origin without any department case.
Active/scheduled policy has actual inclusive start before exclusive expiry under D34; REVOKED preserves original history and actual earlier revocation.
A department-origin policy proposal is not current delegation; if it exists its requester cannot self-approve the Owner decision. No retroactive authorization.
Local RECORDED receipt acknowledges only the exact notice; no wider/new local authority, payment, budget, rights or case approval follows from receipt.
Wrong target, changed same revision, stale or conflicting policy HOLD; expiry/revocation preserves lawful liabilities while current operator authority is arranged.
Receipt statuses:
RECORDED; HELD_WRONG_DEPARTMENT; HELD_CONFLICT; HELD_STALE; NEEDS_CLARIFICATION

#### Field definitions

| Field / logical type | Record requiredness | Meaning | Controls / references |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| provider_id<br>qualified_local_id | Nullable: No | Verified local provider identity. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| provider_statement_id<br>text | Nullable: No | Provider business statement identity. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| provider_revision<br>integer | Nullable: No | Version of same statement, not a new income stream. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| statement_period_start<br>utc_instant | Nullable: No | Agreed period start inclusive. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| statement_period_end<br>utc_instant | Nullable: No | Agreed period end exclusive. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| currency<br>code | Nullable: No | PHP only for accepted classroom examples. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| net_entitlement_centavos<br>integer | Nullable: No | FULL reconciled signed entitlement position for this statement revision; latest independently reconciled revision replaces previous full position. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No; Unit: PHP_centavos |
| reconciliation_status<br>code | Nullable: No | Received/disputed/reconciled, with independent reviewer evidence. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| verified_at<br>utc_instant | Nullable: Yes | When authoritative statement verification completed. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| supersedes_statement_event_id<br>qualified_local_id | Nullable: Yes | Prior full revision of same statement identity; null only for initial statement. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| statement_delta_centavos<br>integer | Nullable: No | Derived latest full position minus prior full position (zero opening initially); audit/ledger movement only, never replacement report value. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No; Unit: PHP_centavos |
| covered_accounting_month<br>year_month | Nullable: No | Single Asia/Manila report month supported by statement or reviewed provider allocation; cross-month unsupported attribution stays unavailable. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| independent_reconciliation_ref<br>protected_evidence_reference | Nullable: Yes | Independent Finance verification; absent for received/disputed drafts. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| allocation_manifest<br>creator_allocation_manifest | Nullable: Yes | Complete independently reviewed expected allocation-key/full-position set for selected statement revision, including closed/discontinued keys; absent while unresolved. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |

Rules:
Natural identity is provider_id + provider_statement_id + currency + original covered period. Conflicting reuse of a revision is quarantined; missing predecessor revision is held for reconciliation, not presumed zero.
Only latest RECONCILED full revision per natural identity enters the replacement report. Verified earlier revisions remain until superseded; a received/disputed revision cannot erase verified evidence.
Provider delta-only notifications need a verified predecessor and independently reconstructed full statement position; no ambiguous signed field is accepted as both full position and delta.
Cash receipt and work attribution require separate evidence. No allocating a whole provider period to titles or calendar months by reading share.
Selected report revision requires a complete independently reviewed allocation manifest. A changed beneficiary/agreement/segment key explicitly closes old key to0 and carries its reversal delta into the new manifest; latest-per-key across all historical revisions is insufficient. Missing allocation review makes creator/retained components UNAVAILABLE, not zero payable or assumed retained income.
Supports reports:
manga_ad_settlements_monthly
Status: PROPOSED_FOR_REVIEW

| allocation_key<br>text | Nullable: No | Stable natural key: statement identity + agreement version + beneficiary + supported work-attribution/terms segment, unchanged by a revised statement. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| allocation_revision<br>integer | Nullable: No | Positive full-position version under allocation_key, with exact statement revision. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| rate_numerator<br>integer | Nullable: No | Exact effective agreement fraction numerator; nonnegative and no greater than denominator. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| rate_denominator<br>integer | Nullable: No | Positive exact fraction denominator. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| terms_effective_segment<br>half_open_utc_interval | Nullable: No | Supported nonoverlapping earnings segment governed by this exact agreement version. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| payable_position_centavos<br>integer | Nullable: No | FULL cumulative earned creator obligation for this allocation revision before actual cash settlement; correction may reduce prior earned position. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No; Unit: PHP_centavos |
| supersedes_allocation_event_id<br>qualified_local_id | Nullable: Yes | Prior full allocation revision, null only initially. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| rounding_policy_ref<br>versioned_record_reference | Nullable: No | Effective agreed rounding/remainder policy; recommended exact rational half-even only if adopted, signed agreement takes precedence. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| beneficiary_dispute_state<br>code | Nullable: No | CLEAR, HOLD_DISPUTED or RESOLVED; disputed payout authority does not erase supported accrued obligation. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| work_basis_pool_ref<br>versioned_record_reference | Nullable: No | One evidenced work-attribution pool, partitioned once from provider total; multiple lawful beneficiaries may share this same basis. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| allocation_manifest_ref<br>versioned_record_reference | Nullable: No | Exact complete selected statement-revision manifest, including zero closures. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| replaces_allocation_key<br>text | Nullable: Yes | Old beneficiary/agreement/segment key being corrected; old key must explicitly close in same reviewed manifest. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| allocation_position_state<br>code | Nullable: No | ACTIVE_FULL_POSITION or CLOSED_ZERO_POSITION; closure preserves economic and paid/recovery lineage. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |

Rules:
Report selects latest independently approved FULL positions per allocation_key for its selected statement revision; never sum historical full versions or substitute payable_delta_centavos for full obligation.
Provider WORK attribution pools must partition covered basis without duplicate work attribution. Legitimate co-beneficiaries can share one evidenced pool; pool basis is counted once and their exact agreed fractions separately. A mid-period rate change requires exact supported earnings segments; unsupported segmentation or beneficiary allocation is HOLD, not guessed from days or reads.
Recommended arithmetic uses exact integer numerator/denominator and half-even centavo rounding per agreed allocation unit. Shared pool residuals require explicit agreed stable allocation ordering; no invented beneficiary or silent loss of a centavo.
Full entitlement = covered full creator allocations + retained full position, including explicitly unattributed income. Negative corrections preserve lineage and require review.
Already paid 300 against revised earned 240 creates a separately reviewed 60 recovery/credit case; never automatic negative payout or bank clawback. Entitlement correction is not cash evidence.
Complete manifest rekey witness: oldA30000 closes to0 (delta-30000), newB24000 opens (delta+24000); full creator position24000 and net ledger change-6000. If A already paid30000, preserve separate reviewed recoveryA30000 and payableB24000; never transfer cash/identity by rewriting the payee.
Co-beneficiary witness: one work pool100000, fractions2/10 and1/10 produce20000+10000, retained70000; shared basis does not become200000 and is not invalid merely because both beneficiaries reference it. Aggregate allocation cannot exceed supported distributable pool under its agreed terms.
Supports reports:
manga_ad_settlements_monthly
Status: PROPOSED_FOR_REVIEW

#### Field definitions

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| service_adjustment_centavos<br>integer | Nullable: No | NONNEGATIVE total approved consideration reduction, including credits already cash-settled. Full latest position, never subtract a negative credit. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No; Unit: PHP_centavos |
| terminated_effective_at<br>utc_instant | Nullable: Yes | Confirmed early termination if remedy requires it. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| is_first_paid_period<br>boolean | Nullable: No | Derived from qualified local history, not every checkout. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| adjustment_revision<br>integer | Nullable: No | Full consideration-reduction position revision; changes have separate signed financial ledger deltas. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| economic_remedy_refs<br>list_of_versioned_record_references | Nullable: No | Deduplicated remedies behind approved reduction; same credit and its cash refund count once. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| net_consideration_centavos<br>integer | Nullable: No | consideration_centavos minus service_adjustment_centavos; nonnegative, after reviewed distinct remedies. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No; Unit: PHP_centavos |
| service_availability_refs<br>list_of_versioned_record_references | Nullable: No | Evidence for promised platform service actually provided/lost, including any unresolved service dispute. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| activation_evidence_ref<br>protected_evidence_reference | Nullable: No | Verified actual activation; no fabricated backdated access from late provider event. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| prepaid_policy_version_ref<br>versioned_record_reference | Nullable: No | Explicit offer/checkout handling version; AN-PREPAID-P1 is a proposed recommendation, not silently adopted. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| recognition_schedule<br>service_recognition_schedule | Nullable: Yes | Independently reviewed full segment allocation of latest NET consideration to promised service/accounting periods, linked credit reasons and availability evidence. Null while unresolved; no final earned amount from a universal cap formula. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |

Rules:
Accepted base offer has no automatic renewal/trial/grace. Proposed AN-PREPAID-P1 uses verified actual activation for exactly30 UTC days, one unresolved checkout and no overlapping purchase/queue; exception captures require reconciliation/remedy, not invented extra entitlement.
Gross consideration = approved consideration reductions + net consideration. Net consideration = cumulative net earned + remaining unearned/refundable obligation. Actual cash refunds settle liabilities separately; they do not deduct the same approved credit a second time.
Earned service requires supported provided-service evidence AND an independently reviewed net-consideration allocation schedule. Voluntary nonuse counts provided access; material platform outage does not. One unavailable title does not automatically prove the whole offer unavailable.
Allocate full net consideration across disjoint exact service segments with independent Finance review. For an ordinary fully promised fixed period or pre-service price concession, allocate net price over the full promised period. A credited verified non-delivery segment has the reviewed reduction and service scope assigned explicitly; do not reduce other provided service twice. Each segment uses allocated net consideration times supported provided measure / promised segment measure; exact cumulative rounding and final centavo true-up conserve allocation.
Scheduled expiry does not force unresolved unprovided service into revenue, and does not autoextend access. Unresolved amount remains unearned/refundable pending reviewed remedy. Service-loss and credit allocation cannot independently double-reduce the same economic effect.
Financial account linkage is minimized on closure subject to separately reviewed obligations; no blanket ledger deletion.
Service allocation variants are explicit: fully provided30days at gross20000 less pre-service price concession2000 => net18000; first12days7200 and remaining18days10800. For gross20000, one credited non-delivery day667 and29 provided days, reviewed net19333 is allocated to the29 provided promised days. No approved credit on same loss leaves667 unearned/refundable. A full pre-service refund allocates0 and earns0. Unknown credit-to-service allocation is HOLD/UNAVAILABLE, not inferred by min(gross-rate,net) for every credit reason.
Accepted D34 service rounding is exact rational centavo HALF_UP plus deterministic final-period true-up. A new general half-even recommendation never overrides this accepted rule.
Recognition schedule must bind the exact referenced paid-period interval and latest reviewed net consideration. Segments partition the whole period without gaps/overlap, including zero-allocation credited non-delivery portions. Time-proportional allocations use exact supported interval duration under the reviewed credit-to-service basis, with cumulative HALF_UP and final true-up. No arbitrary one-second segment may receive the whole30-day price. A typed reviewer reference is not itself verification of this source/policy correspondence; missing proof is HOLD/UNAVAILABLE.
Supports reports:
anime_subscriptions_monthly
Status: PROPOSED_FOR_REVIEW

Rules:
FIFO uses accepted lot chronology and stable tie-break within SKU/location; no multiplying cost by invoice/title joins.
Return links original issues and is valued only for supported recoverable goods; quarantined/restockable quantity decisions are separate.
Picking does not transfer warehouse custody. Dispatch moves owned units to in-transit support; delivery transfers control and matches original issue cost once. Rejected or lost shipment preserves custody/liability evidence and a reviewed exception.
Equal-unit reviewed lot101centavos/3 assigns stable ordinals costs34,34,33, preserving101. Return uses the exact original unit cost, not today price or newly rounded average.
Unknown freight/cost allocation holds final valuation and margin; physical quantity can still be AVAILABLE. No multiplication of nullable/unknown unit cost as zero.

| remedy_state<br>code | Nullable: No | RECEIVED, MORE_INFO_REQUIRED, REVIEW_REQUIRED, APPROVED, DENIED, PARTIALLY_FULFILLED or CLOSED; receiving a claim requires no prior approval. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| economic_remedy_key<br>text | Nullable: No | Common remedy identity linking credit, refund, chargeback and any estimate usage. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| physical_return_portions<br>list_of_versioned_record_references | Nullable: No | Separate immutable return receipts/inspections allow partial/staggered physical returns. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |
| provider_cash_outcome_refs<br>list_of_versioned_record_references | Nullable: No | Actual pending/confirmed/failed refund and chargeback facts; different external facts are reconciled, not silently ignored. | Classification: RESTRICTED_LOCAL; Central raw export: No |

Rules:
PHP 2,000 limit controls internal approval routing, not eligibility for legally required remedies.
Keep item contact/evidence data in this short-lived support case; retain separately minimized financial entries/issue links under FINANCIAL_5Y.
Refund or credit alone never increases available stock.
Support contacts expire under CONTACTS_90_AFTER_CLOSURE; minimized authority/credit/cash/issue lineage is a separate FINANCIAL_5Y projection. Split purposes rather than retaining raw correspondence five years.
A pending refund and a later chargeback on the same charge require reconciliation of actual provider outcomes and the one approved economic remedy. An internal pending flag is not proof against double external settlement.
Inspected physical returns are portion events linked to exact original delivery units; cash-only goodwill, credit, actual return and expected return estimate are different components.
Supports reports:
merch_sales_monthly; merch_inventory_daily
Status: PROPOSED_FOR_REVIEW

Rules:
Ordinary unpaid hold expiry cannot release committed paid-order stock.
Late capture after expired hold requires new allocation or reviewed remedy; no oversell proof from an arithmetic helper.
After fulfillment/abandonment minimize customer linkage; retain only required stock/financial evidence.
paid_units = paid_warehouse_units + paid_in_transit_units + paid_delivered_units + paid_cancelled_settled_units + paid_owed_unallocated_units; all disjoint nonnegative. unpaid_held_units is separate and cannot also count as paid.
Warehouse reserved = eligible unpaid_held_units + paid_warehouse_units only. Paid5/dispatch2 leaves warehouse3, transit2. Picked units remain warehouse until actual dispatch.
One owned quarantined unit with paid demand moves paid_warehouse1 to paid_owed_unallocated1; on_hand1, quarantine1,reserved0,available0. Customer claim persists until eligible reallocation or approved remedy.
Exact unpaid hold timeout is approved configuration referenced by policy version, not a free-form customer input; missing config prevents new reservable checkout, not recording actual provider capture.

merch_inventory_daily
Status: PROPOSED_FOR_REVIEW

Field rules:
Every record belongs to exactly one owning department, including shared financial shape reused locally; no merged central operational ledger.
Identifiers are department-qualified and typed by business entity; foreign record references need explicit owner verification.
Requiredness and logical types here are proposed internal definitions; no SQL type, migration, PK/FK or diagram is generated.
All raw fields are non-exportable by default; approved aggregates are separately defined in pa06_report_definitions.json.
Shared business handoff fields are defined separately in pa06_approval_records.json and pa06_coordination_records.json; typed nested definitions in pa06_logical_types.json.
Successor verification obligations:
Derive and verify technical designs/physical keys/protocols and implementations against this accepted baseline; retain independent actual source/case/batch evidence and authorization.
Instance-specific missing terms, rights, attribution, cost or provider facts still produce the specified HOLD/UNAVAILABLE; business acceptance does not fabricate them.
Logical types reference: pa06_logical_types.json
Record version rule: Each revision is immutable. Record version is source history, not permission to sum full positions. Per-family accounting below distinguishes replacement positions from ledger deltas.

#### manga_title_engagement_monthly

Dataset id: manga_title_engagement_monthly
Department: MANGA
Status: ACCEPTED_CLASSROOM_DEFINITION

Source processes:
M-A-08; MG-S06; MG-S09
Local evidence records:
ReadingEvent; Release; AgreementGrant; ETLRun
Inclusion and cohort rule: Count one logical eligible reading-unit attempt only after authorized content delivery, identified locally by work/release version/session/attempt. Starts grouped by local start month; completion belongs to its original start cohort and may restate that month. Signed-in accounts only for this report scope, without preventing otherwise authorized anonymous reading. Exclude bots/test/staff fixtures marked nonproduction, denied reads and duplicate retries.

#### Measures

| Field / logical type | Record requiredness | Meaning | Controls / references |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| read_starts<br>integer | Nullable: No | Distinct eligible reading-unit attempt starts in cohort, not page refreshes or cash. | Unit: attempts; Aggregation: FLOW_ADDITIVE; Classification: CONFIDENTIAL_AGGREGATE |
| read_completions<br>integer | Nullable: No | At most one completion per counted start, based on explicit final required page/end-of-text reached for its exact release version; no invented elapsed-time threshold. | Unit: attempts; Aggregation: FLOW_ADDITIVE; Classification: CONFIDENTIAL_AGGREGATE |
| title_distinct_readers<br>integer | Nullable: No | Distinct local authenticated accounts among this work/start-month cohort; identities used locally only. | Unit: local_accounts; Aggregation: NONADDITIVE_ACROSS_WORKS_OR_MONTHS; Classification: CONFIDENTIAL_AGGREGATE |
| completion_rate<br>decimal | Nullable: Yes | Recalculate from total components for compatible cohorts; zero starts -> null/NOT_APPLICABLE. Never average row percentages. | Unit: ratio; Aggregation: NONADDITIVE_RATIO; Classification: CONFIDENTIAL_AGGREGATE; Formula: read_completions / read_starts; null if read_starts == 0 |

Reconciliation: Every completion references a counted eligible start; completions <= starts; distinct reader count <= starts. Reconcile report components to deduplicated local attempt set.
Owner view limitation: Title accounts do not establish company-unique people or viewer-to-buyer conversion; small-cohort release still requires separate privacy approval.
Potential central release: Yes
Release authorized: No
Correction rule: immutable source adjustment + complete replacement report partition at a higher revision; never add old and new replacement totals

Availability rule: Value requiredness/types apply inside AVAILABLE. WITHHELD/UNAVAILABLE/NOT_APPLICABLE carry no fabricated numeric value. Freshness is separate. Privacy WITHHELD removes entire customer-derived row/components/rates; safe metadata must not reveal its cohort size.
Aggregation guard: All sums require compatible grain, currency, scope, definition version and latest approved full replacement revision; distinct accounts/ratios/snapshots retain their declared nonadditivity.

### Publication control

Raw personal data central: FORBIDDEN_BY_DEFAULT
Cohort policy: D35 accepts the stated cohort/whole-row/complementary/metadata controls for the classroom model. Each actual release still requires independent purpose/content/privacy permission; aggregate alone is not proof of anonymity.
Missing vs zero: Unavailable/suppressed/not-applicable remains explicitly unavailable, never silently zero; no percentage from missing denominator.
Revision rule: Source owner publishes immutable corrections and complete replacement partitions; same identity/revision with conflicting content quarantined; old replacement totals never added to new totals.
Approval rule: Department Steward and required finance/privacy reviewers approve exact dataset/version/period/columns; successful send, intake, validation and publication are separate.
Refresh rule: Propose monthly reports after source reconciliation; daily inventory after local close, not real-time promises. Display source through-time, report revision, generated time and approved release time. Exact deadlines not selected.
Identity rule: Stable department-owned qualified local IDs; canonical IP mapping only with evidence/effective version. No IP is required for unrelated acquired anime; no inferred grants from identity.
Typed availability reference: pa06_logical_types.json

# Privacy, retention and accepted operating rules


## Accepted classroom privacy and retention rules

Source: knowledge-system/specs/pa06_privacy_retention_proposal.json
Definition approval: accepted business/logical baseline 1.0; source record metadata ACCEPTED_CLASSROOM_SPECIFICATION.
Real personal data authorized: No
Source: NPC Data Privacy Act section 11, https://privacy.gov.ph/data-privacy-act/; principles only, no source endorses the durations below
Customer identity: Separate department-scoped reader, subscriber and buyer accounts; no inferred identity link from shared email or shared IP/work. A company staff identity may hold scoped roles, but cannot self-approve restricted cases. Identity-provider technology is still not selected.
Owner access: Purpose-approved company aggregates and approval/case summaries; no raw watch/read history, customer contact/payment credentials or supplier bank/contract scans by default.

### Small cohort proposal

Minimum distinct accounts: 10
Rule: Withhold the entire customer-derived row and derived components/rates for positive cohorts below 10; do not substitute zero. Apply complementary suppression for totals/overlapping slices, and hold publication where differencing cannot be controlled.
Zero rule: A true zero row is distinct from withheld or unavailable; release still requires purpose/disclosure review.
Limitations: D35 adopts this scoped classroom disclosure rule, without claiming automatic anonymization or Philippine legal compliance. The entire historical D30 simulation remains unapproved. Synthetic low-count demo data must be visibly labelled fictional, not represented as privacy-safe real customer data.
Metadata side channel case: A singleton-work partition can reveal a positive small cohort through existence, row count, digest changes, keys or comparison with prior publication even when the row values are withheld. Disclosure review must withhold/deny the entire partition or unsafe manifest metadata where necessary. A typed suppressed-row token is not proof of privacy.

### Retention classes


#### ACTIVITY_90

Id: ACTIVITY_90
Record scope: Raw reading/watch attempts and intervals
Duration: 90
Unit: days
Clock starts: Original event occurrence
Purpose: Local support, dedup and reviewed monthly calculation/correction window
Disposition: Remove person-linked raw activity or demonstrably de-identify only after risk review; retain permitted nonidentifying reconciliation evidence. Later distinct-account reconstruction is not promised.

#### ACCOUNT_30_AFTER_CLOSURE

Id: ACCOUNT_30_AFTER_CLOSURE
Record scope: Customer account/profile/contact
Duration: 30
Unit: days
Clock starts: Verified account closure after needed identity checks
Purpose: Complete closure, unresolved service requests and communication
Disposition: Delete/minimize profile identifiers unless separately justified for unresolved financial/security/legal records; do not delete ledger history indiscriminately.

#### CONTACTS_90_AFTER_CLOSURE

Id: CONTACTS_90_AFTER_CLOSURE
Record scope: Shipping/return contact detail and claim correspondence
Duration: 90
Unit: days
Clock starts: Last related fulfillment/remedy case closure
Purpose: Resolve delivery/return communications
Disposition: Remove contact/free-text evidence not needed; keep minimized transaction/issue/credit proof under its distinct financial class.

#### FINANCIAL_5Y

Id: FINANCIAL_5Y
Record scope: Minimal contracts/grants, approval, finance and owned stock provenance
Duration: 5
Unit: calendar_years
Clock starts: Later of final obligation closure and agreement/claim expiry
Purpose: Reconciliation, rights/authority proof and simulated dispute/audit support
Disposition: Review legal/contractual need and holds before removal; five years is invented classroom retention, not a statement of actual Philippine tax/copyright limitation rules.

#### SECURITY_365

Id: SECURITY_365
Record scope: Minimal local authentication/access/security diagnostic events; decision/authority/financial proof belongs to FINANCIAL_5Y, even when called approval audit.
Duration: 365
Unit: days
Clock starts: Event occurrence
Purpose: Investigate unauthorized access/approval anomalies
Disposition: Remove unneeded identifiable detail after review; exclude secrets and raw content from logs.

#### REPORTS_24M

Id: REPORTS_24M
Record scope: Approved minimized aggregate report revisions and manifests
Duration: 24
Unit: calendar_months
Clock starts: End of source report period
Purpose: Two-year classroom trend/correction demonstration
Disposition: Review whether report is identifying or under an active hold; remove or retain justified nonidentifying history only.

### Holds and deletion

Hold rule: Document case, scope, reason, reviewer and next review date; restrict access while a valid obligation/claim requires preservation. A hold is not indefinite consent to keep everything.
Correction after erasure: Never recreate deleted person-level history from aggregates. Mark unavailable reconstructions and preserve only permitted source-independent financial/correction evidence.
Backup target days after eligibility: 30
Backup rule: Proposed design target only: delete eligible primary replicas and let protected backups age out within 30 days; restore must reapply deletion/hold instructions before general access. Actual backup provider and deletion verification are not implemented.
Deletion receipt: Record minimally necessary disposal/hold outcome without retaining the deleted content itself.
Report correction limit: ACTIVITY_90 raw activity and REPORTS_24M aggregates have different purposes. After permitted raw deletion, correction can use surviving permitted nonidentifying evidence; exact distinct accounts or unsupported finer grain becomes UNAVAILABLE/RECONSTRUCTION_LIMIT, never invented or justification for permanent raw retention.
Adoption boundary: D35 accepts these scoped classroom privacy/retention/identity/attribution rules. Exact thresholds/durations are project policy, not law or anonymization certification. No fullD30 adoption, real personal-data authorization or individual export release.
Retention classification rule: Classify each minimized projection by actual purpose: authority/decision/economic lineage FINANCIAL_5Y; access/security diagnostics SECURITY_365; raw support contacts CONTACTS_90_AFTER_CLOSURE. A broad audit table cannot pick the shortest or longest class for unrelated purposes.

### Multi ip financial recommendation

Id: PA06-IP-TAG-P1
Status: ADOPTED_CLASSROOM_RULE
Initial policy: Canonical reviewed IP links are descriptive tags only for multi-IP SKU/project financials. Preserve original SKU/project grain; do not sum whole value once per tag. No weighted allocation initially.
Unmapped rule: A qualified local source can exist with UNMAPPED status; Central IP financial slice is unavailable until reviewed canonical mapping. Never drop original valid source transaction or guess ancestor IP.
Single ip rule: A single independently reviewed exclusive canonical IP may be grouped once; tags and financial allocation remain distinct concepts.

## Accepted provider, hold, prepaid and attribution choices

Source: knowledge-system/specs/pa06_operating_choices.json
Definition approval: accepted business/logical baseline 1.0; source record metadata ACCEPTED_CLASSROOM_SPECIFICATION.
Accepted predecessors:
D33; D34
Purpose: Accepted version1.0 classroom information-stage rules. Synthetic canonical adapters, hold/prepaid handling and financial attribution/rounding govern derived designs; no real integration or automatic publication is implied.

### Provider mode

Recommendation: SYNTHETIC_CANONICAL_ADAPTERS_ONLY
Ad statements: MOCK_AD_V1 produces immutable full statement revisions and separately verified attribution/cash evidence; no selected real advertising network.
Payments: MOCK_PAY_V1 records authoritative synthetic event/transaction/original-charge identities, amounts, currency, effective time, occurrence kind and validation evidence. No real money, credentials or provider service promised.
Shipping: MOCK_SHIP_V1 records synthetic handover/in-transit/delivered/failed/lost/returned evidence. A label or an unverified buyer click is not dispatch/delivery proof.
Video: MOCK_MEDIA_V1 uses synthetic placeholder media and explicit entitled/rights/media/territory/time checks. It demonstrates access decisions, without claiming real encryption, DRM, vendor protection or licensed media delivery.
Identity: MOCK_IDENTITY_V1 keeps separate qualified reader/subscriber/buyer accounts, supports company staff with scoped roles and independent approval evidence. No email-based cross-department customer matching or selected SSO vendor.

### Payment canonical contract

Required observed fact fields:
provider_identity; provider_event_identity; provider_transaction_identity; original_charge_identity; event_kind; amount_centavos; currency; occurred_at; verification_evidence
Event kinds:
PENDING
AUTHORIZED
CAPTURE_CONFIRMED
DECLINED
VOID_CONFIRMED
REFUND_PENDING
REFUND_CONFIRMED
REFUND_FAILED
CHARGEBACK_OPENED
CHARGEBACK_CONFIRMED
CHARGEBACK_REVERSED
Requiredness: Original-charge identity is conditional: the original capture uses its own charge identity; refund/chargeback/reversal must reference it. Unknown local obligation is retained as an unresolved incoming fact and never granted to a guessed account/order. Local obligation is nullable while UNMATCHED; receipt identity and provider fact are retained in a dedicated local observation record. DepartmentFinanceEntry is a separate post-matching projection, never a substitute for the unmatched observation.
Event order: Do not treat occurrence kinds as one linear replaceable status. Preserve verified facts, occurrence and received times. A late PENDING/DECLINED notification cannot erase a confirmed capture. Conflicting same-event content is quarantined; independent query/reconciliation resolves authority.
Deduplication: Same provider event identity/content is one observed fact; distinct event IDs for same transaction/economic effect still have one capture/refund effect. More than one actual charge is recorded as actual overcharge, not hidden by deduplication.
Granting: Only verified expected capture, correct obligation/amount/currency and completed independent eligibility gates authorize one agreed access/order effect. Browser redirect, screenshot, authorization without capture or unmatched capture grants nothing.
Unexpected capture: Record real/synthetic verified capture even after timeout/cancellation. Reconcile new eligible allocation or reviewed customer remedy. Anime does not silently create a second period/queue; Merchandise does not oversell.
Refunds and disputes: Actual partial refunds and chargebacks remain separate linked provider facts. One economic remedy can have a credit and cash settlement without doubling consideration reduction. Verified external over-settlement is an exception liability/recovery case; never discarded to make an internal total look valid.
Pending or failed: Pending/failed refund is not settled cash and does not close unresolved remedy. Verified chargeback may change confirmed cash exposure without retroactively proving a lawful local approval or delivery event.
Conditional match fields:
local_obligation_reference
Amount rule: Canonical capture/refund/chargeback amount is a nonnegative integer PHP-centavo magnitude; occurrence kind determines direction. Preserve protected provider representation and independently verify any sign/unit normalization. Fee/net-transfer components are separate; never subtract a negative refund a second time. Unsupported currency or amount mismatch is retained for reconciliation without granting a local effect.

### Unpaid stock hold

Recommendation id: PA06-HOLD-P1
Status: ADOPTED_CLASSROOM_RULE
Duration seconds: 900
Starts at: Authoritative atomic successful local hold creation in UTC
Boundary: Active for created_at <= now < expires_at; expired at exact expiry unless already converted by verified valid capture and allocation decision. Serialize competing payment/expiry outcomes in implementation.
Paid rule: Paid allocations have no basket expiry. Partial dispatch retains remaining paid warehouse allocation. Recall suspends affected sellable unit allocation while preserving paid owed demand.
Late capture: Expiry releases only unpaid physical hold. Late capture records fact and requires new eligible allocation or reviewed remedy. No automatic resurrection of consumed stock.
Retry rule: An exact retry returns the original hold identity and expiry; browser refresh does not restart its900second lifetime. A new eligible hold requires a new independently validated allocation, never revival of expired/consumed units.

### Anime prepaid

Recommendation id: AN-PREPAID-P1
Status: ADOPTED_CLASSROOM_RULE
Rule: One unresolved checkout per account/offer; reject a new purchase while currently entitled or unresolved. No queue, overlap or backdated entitlement. Verified actual activation starts exactly 2592000 UTC seconds. Unexpected actual captures require reconciliation/remedy; no automatic second period or outage extension.
Unchanged accepted offer: PHP200 for30days, no automatic renewal, trial or grace under D34.

### Money and attribution

Rounding recommendation: Accepted D34 subscriber service uses exact rational half-UP to centavo and deterministic final-period true-up. Only otherwise-unagreed economic allocation units propose half-even; effective signed agreements and accepted D34 take precedence. Never use binary floating-point or round intermediate report sums.
Equal unit lot remainder: Only after reviewed cost basis and equal-unit allocation are supported: divide authoritative integer lot total by unit count; give first remainder stable original unit ordinals one extra centavo. Returned/reissued unit keeps original ordinal cost. No assumed freight allocation.
Creator segmentation: Use provider-supported work/earnings attribution and exact effective agreement segments. Unknown mid-period split or beneficiary authority is HOLD, no invented equal allocation, guessed rate, read-count allocation or automatic clawback.
Multi ip financial: PA06-IP-TAG-P1: keep project/SKU financial grain; multi-IP tags descriptive only, no weighted allocation initially. A single exclusive reviewed IP can group once. UNMAPPED preserves valid local source but blocks unsupported Central IP slice.
Sku path: Immutable source-path-specific SKU under accepted D34; separate wholesale versus commissioned variants even if visually similar. Actual delivery/returns retain original issue/lot total-cost lineage.
Expected returns: Independently reviewed supported outstanding refund liability/recovery asset positions; no invented default return rate. Realized remedy consumes expectation once. Unsupported valuation becomes UNAVAILABLE, not zero.

This pointer never authorizes earnings beyond exact floor/ceiling bounds or bypasses cumulative HALF_UP/source-period verification. | No additional field-local constraint. |

#### Rules

Rules — entry 1
Kind: recognition_segment
Meaning: Reviewed exact time-based service/accounting segment. Promised measure equals its full exact rational UTC interval duration, including a separately declared zero-allocation credited/non-service segment. Provided union is bounded by that interval. No arbitrary denominator, omitted excluded interval, gross-rate shortcut or invented short segment may earn full net consideration.
Rounding bound: Earned amount is only the floor or ceiling of exact allocated-net consideration times supported provided duration divided by the exact interval-bound promise. A rounding_trueup_reference is provenance only and never overrides this bound. Larger corrections are separate independently reviewed financial adjustments, not service rounding.

| net_consideration_centavos<br>NonnegativeInteger | Required: Yes<br>Nullable: No | Latest supported whole-period net consideration after reviewed credits/concessions; segment allocations must conserve this amount. | No additional field-local constraint. |
| segments<br>Kind: list; Items: ServiceRecognitionSegment; Min items: 0 | Required: Yes<br>Nullable: No | Reviewed disjoint service/accounting allocations for this period; an empty schedule cannot silently imply all consideration was earned. | No additional field-local constraint. |
| reviewer_reference<br>VersionedReference | Required: Yes<br>Nullable: No | Actual independent Finance review approving the full net allocation, credit linkage, duration and conservation basis. | No additional field-local constraint. |
| net_earned_centavos<br>NonnegativeInteger | Required: Yes<br>Nullable: No | Sum of the schedule's supported earned net centavos across its current reviewed segments; distinct from captured cash. | No additional field-local constraint. |
| unearned_centavos<br>NonnegativeInteger | Required: Yes<br>Nullable: No | Remaining supported net consideration not yet earned across the schedule; net earned plus unearned must equal net consideration. | No additional field-local constraint. |


#### Rules

Rules — entry 1
Kind: recognition_schedule
Meaning: Full independently reviewed latest NET consideration allocation to the exact referenced paid period. Complete segment coverage, exact interval-bound denominators and source-matching reviewed proportional allocation are necessary; arithmetic conservation alone does not prove the actual source/review.
Source binding requirements:
Independently resolve paid_period_reference to the exact retained original PaidAccessPeriod revision; descriptor equality alone never proves that source.
paid_service_interval equals that original source interval; net_consideration_centavos equals its latest independently reviewed net consideration after distinct credits, without cash-application duplication.
All segments form one complete gap-free non-overlapping partition of that original paid-service interval. Credited non-service portions are explicit separately reviewed zero-allocation segments, never silently omitted or used to reduce another provided segment twice.
Each segment promised_measure_seconds equals its entire exact declared interval duration. Sum promised measures equals the exact parent interval duration.
Net consideration allocation across those segments follows the actual reviewed service/credit scope and time-proportional contract basis. A changed arbitrary one-second segment cannot absorb the whole price just because totals add up; its allocation must match the independently retained allocation review.
Referenced review/rounding policy remains the accepted D34/actual contract policy, including HALF_UP for the accepted prepaid illustration; no new rounding or allocation rule is selected here.
Actual parent/source and independently retained proportional allocation must be checked before financial acceptance; a typed review pointer does not bypass exact supported earning or rounding bounds.
Rounding rule: For the accepted D34 prepaid illustration, total earned is exact rational HALF_UP of the sum of supported per-segment net earnings. Chronological segments use HALF_UP individually except the last eligible positive-earned-scope segment, which carries only the exact residual needed to match that conserved total, still inside its own floor/ceiling bound. Zero/unprovided allocation earns zero. An infeasible/unresolved residual remains HOLD, never an arbitrary amount authorized by a pointer.

Reference convention: Fields may use type_ref pa06_logical_types.json#/types/<CanonicalName>. Existing logical aliases map to a conceptual shape only; no automatic conversion of old payloads or status codes.
Global rules:
No raw document, credential, binary media or unrestricted history is carried by a protected reference; actual role/object/purpose access is independently verified.
All types and examples remain proposed. Shape validity never proves real identity, signature, rights, payment, provider state, privacy safety or adopted retention policy.
Required-but-null pending fields are explicit absence states, not placeholders that claim later independent approval exists. Positive decision states have conditional evidence requirements.
Canonical logical shapes do not select final API technology, wire serialization, generator schema, database constraints or cryptographic provider. Digest algorithm labels are recognized proposed descriptors; final compatibility still requires exact reviewed definition.
AVAILABLE zero remains zero. WITHHELD, UNAVAILABLE and NOT_APPLICABLE carry no numeric value; their distinctions cannot be coerced to zero or null without meaning.
Freshness and observation period are independent of availability: a failed new refresh is not a new verified zero/partition. Prior verified data remain visibly stale under their original revision/cutoff.
An approved complete empty replacement can remove the old partition only under exact scoped reviewed permission and reconciliation. A no-observation, withheld or failed refresh never does so.
When customer-derived privacy protection withholds a row, its components, ratios, keys/side metadata and complementary/overlapping outputs must not expose the hidden value. Structural checks catch explicit leakage; actual statistical disclosure review remains required.
No numeric retention duration or k threshold is adopted here. D35 stays proposed; source period corrections after erased source data cannot fabricate person-level reconstruction.
Fractional elapsed service time and month-boundary splits remain exact rational seconds. No silently truncated timestamps/seconds or chosen physical tick precision; source text and unsupported interpretation are explicit.
Successor verification obligations:
Derive and verify technical designs/physical keys/protocols and implementations against this accepted baseline; retain independent actual source/case/batch evidence and authorization.
Instance-specific missing terms, rights, attribution, cost or provider facts still produce the specified HOLD/UNAVAILABLE; business acceptance does not fabricate them.

#### Scalar aliases

Text: NonemptyText

Iana timezone: NonemptyText

Signed integer: SignedInteger
Nonnegative integer: NonnegativeInteger
Positive integer: PositiveInteger
Integer centavos: SignedInteger

Inline enumeration: enum:A|B|C means exactly the explicit listed scalar values; nonempty and unique. Bare enum is a FIELD-SCOPED code requiring contextual values/reference from the source definition, not an arbitrary object. Grammar recognition alone is not exhaustive state/value parity.
List notation: CanonicalName[] is an array of the resolved explicit canonical item type. list/nonempty_list named aliases or local collection_alias resolve exact known item descriptors; unknown names fail.
Local descriptors: Resolve exact local_nested_types entries or their explicitly declared collection_alias. Local list item_fields/item_type_ref and record fields recursively resolve explicit scalar/enum/list/reference types; no opaque fallback.
Contextual authority codes: canonical_authority_purpose and authority_stage resolve exact PA05 purpose/stage registry values; no arbitrary string alias or generic PROJECT_COMMITMENT execution stage.
External definition: Exact repository document + JSON pointer to an explicitly defined domain-local type; resolve all nested fields/items recursively. Missing document/pointer/undefined item fails. This reuses actual local structures rather than duplicating them or accepting opaque objects.

### Temporal precision policy

Status: PROPOSED_LOGICAL_CONTRACT
Rule: Elapsed service time uses exact rational UTC seconds derived from full original fractional timestamp text. No fixed physical tick, SQL timestamp precision or provider serialization is chosen. Whole integer seconds are exact shorthand; fractional durations require numerator/positive-denominator. Parse calendar whole-second components separately from the complete rational fraction; never let datetime microsecond truncation change ordering, union, accounting-month allocation or revenue.
Unsupported source: Preserve original source text/evidence under SourceTimestampDescriptor; unresolved/unsupported interpretation has no normalized instant and remains HOLD until independently resolved. A technology-specific precision/quantization policy would need explicit later review, conservation and raw-source preservation.

# Downstream traceability and controlled changes


## LOCKED BUSINESS BASELINE

Source: knowledge-system/vault/LOCKED-BUSINESS-BASELINE.md

### Locked business and logical information baseline — version1.0

Baseline ID: LOXADA-BUSINESS-BASELINE-1.0. Accepted and frozen2026-10-24 under D35/D36. The user said “I accept all” in response to the reviewed current package and requested the full locked specification. PA06 is accepted; PA07 business sign-off is complete. All nine former business freeze findings are resolved in the academic business/logical scope. The exact source manifest is phase_a_locked_baseline.json.

#### What the lock governs

The selected company structure, six sourcing paths, three offers, roles/independent authority, rights gates,151business process families,35authority purposes, local logical records/actions, financial/stock/service semantics,8report definitions, identity/privacy/retention and accepted mock/hold/prepaid/attribution choices form the approved baseline. D33/D34 are retained and D35 adopts the current reviewed information-stage package. D36 records this freeze and downstream/change-control requirement.
DFD, ERD, star, galaxy and snowflake models, backend logic, frontend/Figma flows, APIs, ETL/BI and tests must trace to these source IDs/definitions. They may derive technical structures and layouts within the rules. They may not silently add departments, rights, offer terms, authority, statuses, data sharing, measures or financial allocations.

#### What is derived later

Physical database keys/types/indexes/cardinalities, normalized dimension structures, exact wire/API/provider schemas, recursive balanced DFD numbering/routes, Figma layouts/components/interactions and working implementations are successor designs. They must be evidenced and validated; this lock does not pretend they already exist. The user's generators and their input formats remain deferred. Seven report purposes are eligible Central candidates, not actual approved batches; manufacturing reporting remains local.
Actual licences/contracts, source truth, signatures, independent review, service delivery, physical custody/ownership, payment confirmation, case/batch permission and privacy enforcement must still be verified at the point of use. The classroom policies authorize no real personal-data collection, legal/compliance certification or live supplier/payment integration. Full historical D30, older broad candidate catalogues and held technical/prototype proposals are not adopted by this acceptance. Synthetic adapters and labelled fictional data remain the selected mode. Schedule stays off; no automatic merge.

#### Controlled changes

To change a locked business rule: create a numbered change request, state the reason and affected baseline/source IDs, assess DFD/ERD/dimensional/backend/frontend/data/security/test impact, specify migration/reconciliation consequences, obtain explicit authorized acceptance, update affected artifacts and acceptance cases, and publish a new baseline version with a source manifest. The prior baseline remains reproducible.
Routine design choices that preserve every business meaning may be documented in their derived artifact version without reopening business scope. A discovered contradiction is corrected through this procedure; the lock prevents silent drift rather than making mistakes permanent.

#### Final business gate

PA01–PA06 are satisfied in their stated academic scope. The independent whole-business assessment and second review support PA07 completion. There are zero open business freeze blockers; PA-F14/15/16 remain post-freeze technical deliverables. Exact route/wire parity, balanced diagrams, physical schemas, live code/security and native Figma behavior remain separately verified successors. See PA-06-SECOND-REVIEW, PHASE-A-CONSISTENCY-AUDIT and CHECKPOINT.
